quote: In his days the angels of Yahuah (God) descended on the earth, those who are named the Watchers
live_here: And in the second week of the tenth jubilee Mahalalel took to him to wife Dînâh, the daughter of Barâkî’êl the daughter of his father’s brother, and she bare him a son in the third week in the sixth year, and he called his name Jared; for in his days the angels of Yahuah (God) descended on the earth, those who are named the Watchers, that they should instruct the children of men, and that they should do judgment and uprightness on the earth.
live_proposed: And in the second week of the tenth jubilee Mahalalel took to him to wife Dînâh, the daughter of Barâkî’êl the daughter of his father’s brother, and she bare him a son in the third week in the sixth year, and he called his name Jared; for in his days the angels of Yahuah (God) descended on the earth, those who are named the Watchers, that they should instruct the children of men, and that they should do judgment and uprightness on the earth.
note: *And they were in all two hundred; who descended in the days of Jared on the summit of Mount Hermon, and they called it Mount Hermon, because they had sworn and bound themselves by mutual imprecations upon it.* (1 Enoch 6:6). *In his days the angels of Yahuah (God) descended on the earth, those who are named the Watchers* (Jubilees 4:15). Jubilees dates the descent to Jared's days; 1 Enoch dates it the same way and adds the place and the number — two hundred, on the summit of Hermon, bound by an oath. Two books, one generation, one mountain.

quote: There he writes down the condemnation and judgment of the world
live_here: And he was taken from amongst the children of men, and we conducted him into the Garden of Eden in majesty and honour, and behold there he writes down the condemnation and judgment of the world, and all the wickedness of the children of men.
live_proposed: And he was taken from amongst the children of men, and we conducted him into the Garden of Eden in majesty and honour, and behold there he writes down the condemnation and judgment of the world, and all the wickedness of the children of men.
note: *And behold a dream came to me, and visions fell down upon me, and I saw visions of chastisement, and a voice came bidding (me) I to tell it to the sons of heaven, and reprimand them.* (1 Enoch 13:8). *There he writes down the condemnation and judgment of the world* (Jubilees 4:23). The commission Jubilees describes, 1 Enoch shows from the inside: the dream, the visions of chastisement, and the voice telling Enoch to carry it to the sons of heaven and reprimand them. Jubilees says he became the scribe of judgment; 1 Enoch is the judgment he wrote.

quote: Who consumed all the acquisitions of men. And when men could no longer sustain them, the giants turned against them and devoured mankind.
live_here: And lawlessness increased on the earth and all flesh corrupted its way, alike men and cattle and beasts and birds and everything that walks on the earth-all of them corrupted their ways and their orders, and they began to devour each other, and lawlessness increased on the earth and every imagination of the thoughts of all men (was) thus evil continually.
note: *Who consumed all the acquisitions of men. And when men could no longer sustain them, the giants turned against them and devoured mankind.* (1 Enoch 7:3–4). *They began to devour each other* (Jubilees 5:2). Jubilees says all flesh began to devour each other; 1 Enoch says who started it. The giants consumed everything men had, and when men could no longer feed them, the giants turned on mankind and ate them. The devouring of Jubilees 5:2 has a face.

quote: But Noah found grace before the eyes of Yahuah (God)
live_here: But Noah found grace before the eyes of Yahuah (God).
live_proposed: But Noah found grace before the eyes of Yahuah (God).
note: *And now instruct him that he may escape and his seed may be preserved for all the generations of the world.’* (1 Enoch 10:3). *But Noah found grace before the eyes of Yahuah (God)* (Jubilees 5:5). What the grace did, 1 Enoch records as an order given to an angel: instruct him so that he escapes and his seed is preserved for every generation of the world. Grace found Noah; the instruction is what grace looked like.

quote: He sent His sword into their midst that each should slay his neighbour
live_here: And He sent His sword into their midst that each should slay his neighbour, and they began to slay each other till they all fell by the sword and were destroyed from the earth.
live_proposed: And He sent His sword into their midst that each should slay his neighbour, and they began to slay each other till they all fell by the sword and were destroyed from the earth.
note: *And to Gabriel said Yahuah (Lord): ‘Proceed against the bastards and the reprobates, and against the children of fornication: and destroy [the children of fornication and] the children of the Watchers from amongst men [and cause them to go forth]: send them one against the other that they may destroy each other in battle: for length of days shall they not have.* (1 Enoch 10:9). *He sent His sword into their midst that each should slay his neighbour* (Jubilees 5:9). The sword has a name in 1 Enoch: Gabriel, sent against the children of the Watchers to *send them one against the other that they may destroy each other in battle.* Jubilees reports the slaughter; 1 Enoch reports the command that caused it.

quote: Till the day of judgment, on which Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) shall judge them with a sword and with fire
live_here: And they all said, “So be it; so be it,” for themselves and their sons for ever throughout their generations till the day of judgment, on which Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) shall judge them with a sword and with fire, for all the unclean wickedness of their errors, wherewith they have filled the earth with transgression and uncleanness and fornication and sin.
live_proposed: And they all said, “So be it; so be it,” for themselves and their sons for ever throughout their generations till the day of judgment, on which Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) shall judge them with a sword and with fire, for all the unclean wickedness of their errors, wherewith they have filled the earth with transgression and uncleanness and fornication and sin.
note: *And on the day of the great judgement he shall be cast into the fire.* (1 Enoch 10:6). *Till the day of judgment, on which Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) shall judge them with a sword and with fire* (Jubilees 9:15). The day the sons of Noah bound themselves to by oath is the day the bound Watchers are waiting for. 1 Enoch names it the same way — *the day of the great judgement,* and the fire. One day, two books, the same reckoning.

quote: And in the sixth year thereof, she bare him a son, and he called his name Peleg; for in the days when he was born the children of Noah began to divide the earth amongst themselves: for this reason he called his name Peleg.
live_here: And in the sixth year thereof, she bare him a son, and he called his name Peleg; for in the days when he was born the children of Noah began to divide the earth amongst themselves: for this reason he called his name Peleg.
live_proposed: And in the sixth year thereof, she bare him a son, and he called his name Peleg; for in the days when he was born the children of Noah began to divide the earth amongst themselves: for this reason he called his name Peleg.
note: Jubilees 8:8 — *And in the sixth year thereof, she bare him a son, and he called his name Peleg; for in the days when he was born the children of Noah began to divide the earth amongst themselves: for this reason he called his name Peleg.* The division Jubilees 9 details was begun and named one chapter earlier.

quote: The unclean demons began to lead astray the children of the sons of Noah
live_here: And in the third week of this jubilee the unclean demons began to lead astray the children of the sons of Noah; and to make to err and destroy them.
live_proposed: And in the third week of this jubilee the unclean demons began to lead astray the children of the sons of Noah; and to make to err and destroy them.
note: *And now, the giants, who are produced from the spirits and flesh, shall be called evil spirits upon the earth, and on the earth shall be their dwelling.* (1 Enoch 15:8). *The unclean demons began to lead astray the children of the sons of Noah* (Jubilees 10:1). Jubilees calls them unclean demons; 1 Enoch tells you what they are. The giants born of spirits and flesh became evil spirits on the earth when their bodies died, and the earth is their dwelling. The demons troubling Noah's grandsons are the dead giants of the Watchers.

quote: And the chief of the spirits, Mastêmâ, came and said: “Yahuah (God), Creator, let some of them remain before me, and let them hearken to my voice, and do all that I shall say to them; for if some of them are not left to me, I shall not be able to execute the power of my will on the sons of men...”
live_here: And the chief of the spirits, Mastêmâ, came and said: “Yahuah (God), Creator, let some of them remain before me, and let them hearken to my voice, and do all that I shall say to them; for if some of them are not left to me, I shall not be able to execute the power of my will on the sons of men; for these are for corruption and leading astray before my judgment, for great is the wickedness of the sons of men.”
live_proposed: And the chief of the spirits, Mastêmâ, came and said: “Yahuah (God), Creator, let some of them remain before me, and let them hearken to my voice, and do all that I shall say to them; for if some of them are not left to me, I shall not be able to execute the power of my will on the sons of men; for these are for corruption and leading astray before my judgment, for great is the wickedness of the sons of men.”
note: Jubilees 10:8 — *And the chief of the spirits, Mastêmâ, came and said: “Yahuah (God), Creator, let some of them remain before me, and let them hearken to my voice, and do all that I shall say to them; for if some of them are not left to me, I shall not be able to execute the power of my will on the sons of men...”* the tenth-part of spirits whom Jubilees 11:5 now shows Mastêmâ sending out to corrupt and shed blood.

quote: All the signs of the stars, and the signs of the moon and of the sun are all in the hand of Yahuah (God). Why do I search (them) out?
live_here: And a word came into his heart and he said: "All the signs of the stars, and the signs of the moon and of the sun are all in the hand of Yahuah (God). Why do I search (them) out?
live_proposed: And a word came into his heart and he said: "All the signs of the stars, and the signs of the moon and of the sun are all in the hand of Yahuah (God). Why do I search (them) out?
note: *And Uriel said to me: ‘Here shall stand the angels who have connected themselves with women, and their spirits assuming many different forms are defiling mankind and shall lead them astray into sacrificing to demons as gods, (here shall they stand,) till the day of the great judgement in which they shall be judged till they are made an end of.* (1 Enoch 19:1). *All the signs of the stars, and the signs of the moon and of the sun are all in the hand of Yahuah (God). Why do I search (them) out?* (Jubilees 12:17). Abram turns from the stars and, in the next verses, prays to be delivered from the evil spirits that rule men's hearts. Uriel showed Enoch those spirits: the Watchers' spirits in many forms, *lead them astray into sacrificing to demons as gods.* Star-reading was one of the arts they taught. Abram walked away from the art and asked to be kept from its teachers.

quote: But Abraham observed it, and Isaac and Jacob and his children observed it up to your days, and in your days the children of Yashar'el (Israel) forgot it until you celebrated it anew on this mountain.
live_here: But Abraham observed it, and Isaac and Jacob and his children observed it up to your days, and in your days the children of Yashar’el (Israel) forgot it until you celebrated it anew on this mountain.
live_proposed: But Abraham observed it, and Isaac and Jacob and his children observed it up to your days, and in your days the children of Yashar’el (Israel) forgot it until you celebrated it anew on this mountain.
note: Jubilees 6:19 — *But Abraham observed it, and Isaac and Jacob and his children observed it up to your days, and in your days the children of Yashar'el (Israel) forgot it until you celebrated it anew on this mountain.* Jubilees 14:20 shows Abraham renewing the very feast 6:19 says he observed — the patriarchs kept the appointed times, it ain't new.

quote: For this reason it is ordained and written on the heavenly tables, that they should celebrate the feast of weeks in this month once a year, to renew the covenant every year. And this whole festival was celebrated in heaven from the day of creation till the days of Noah-twenty-six jubilees and five weeks of years: and Noah and his sons observed it for seven jubilees and one week of years, till the day of Noah's death, and from the day of Noah's death his sons did away with (it) until the days of Abraham, and they ate blood.
live_here: And this whole festival was celebrated in heaven from the day of creation till the days of Noah-twenty-six jubilees and five weeks of years: and Noah and his sons observed it for seven jubilees and one week of years, till the day of Noah’s death, and from the day of Noah’s death his sons did away with (it) until the days of Abraham, and they ate blood.
live_proposed: And this whole festival was celebrated in heaven from the day of creation till the days of Noah-twenty-six jubilees and five weeks of years: and Noah and his sons observed it for seven jubilees and one week of years, till the day of Noah’s death, and from the day of Noah’s death his sons did away with (it) until the days of Abraham, and they ate blood.
note: Jubilees 6:18 — *For this reason it is ordained and written on the heavenly tables, that they should celebrate the feast of weeks in this month once a year, to renew the covenant every year. And this whole festival was celebrated in heaven from the day of creation till the days of Noah-twenty-six jubilees and five weeks of years: and Noah and his sons observed it for seven jubilees and one week of years, till the day of Noah's death, and from the day of Noah's death his sons did away with (it) until the days of Abraham, and they ate blood.* The covenant Abram renews "as we covenanted with Noah" (Jubilees 14:20) is the Feast of Weeks, engraved on the heavenly tablets and kept since creation.

quote: Over all has He placed spirits in authority to lead them astray from Him
live_here: And He sanctified it, and gathered it from amongst all the children of men ; for there are many nations and many peoples, and all are His, and over all has He placed spirits in authority to lead them astray from Him.
live_proposed: And He sanctified it, and gathered it from amongst all the children of men ; for there are many nations and many peoples, and all are His, and over all has He placed spirits in authority to lead them astray from Him.
note: *And they who worship stones, and grave images of gold and silver and wood and stone and clay, and those who worship impure spirits and demons, and all kinds of idols not according to knowledge, shall get no manner of help from them.* (1 Enoch 99:7). *Over all has He placed spirits in authority to lead them astray from Him* (Jubilees 15:31). The spirits set over the nations are the spirits behind the idols. 1 Enoch names the worship — stones, images of gold and silver and wood and clay, impure spirits and demons — and the result: *no manner of help from them.* The nations were handed to spirits; Yashar'el (Israel) was kept for Yahuah (God) himself. The idols are not empty; they have tenants.

quote: This law is for all the generations for ever, and there is no circumcision of the days, and no omission of one day out of the eight days; for it is an eternal ordinance, ordained and written on the heavenly tables.
live_here: This law is for all the generations for ever, and there is no circumcision of the days, and no omission of one day out of the eight days; for it is an eternal ordinance, ordained and written on the heavenly tables.
live_proposed: This law is for all the generations for ever, and there is no circumcision of the days, and no omission of one day out of the eight days; for it is an eternal ordinance, ordained and written on the heavenly tables.
note: Jubilees 15:25 — *This law is for all the generations for ever, and there is no circumcision of the days, and no omission of one day out of the eight days; for it is an eternal ordinance, ordained and written on the heavenly tables.* The covenant Jubilees 16:14 calls ordained for ever is engraved on the heavenly tables — the eternal sign in the flesh of the seed.

quote: It was commanded and engraven concerning all his seed, on the heavenly tables, to remove them and root them out
live_here: And, behold, it was commanded and engraven concerning all his seed, on the heavenly tables, to remove them and root them out, and to execute judgment upon them like the judgment of Sodom, and to leave no seed of the man on earth on the day of condemnation.
live_proposed: And, behold, it was commanded and engraven concerning all his seed, on the heavenly tables, to remove them and root them out, and to execute judgment upon them like the judgment of Sodom, and to leave no seed of the man on earth on the day of condemnation.
note: *In those days they shall be led off to the abyss of fire: and to the torment and the prison in which they shall be confined for ever.* (1 Enoch 10:13). *It was commanded and engraven concerning all his seed, on the heavenly tables, to remove them and root them out* (Jubilees 16:9). The judgment of Sodom was written before it fell. 1 Enoch shows the same pattern for the Watchers: their end was fixed — led off to the abyss of fire, to the torment and the prison, for ever. The sentence is written before the day; the day only executes it.

quote: And he built booths for himself and for his servants on this festival, and he was the first to celebrate the feast of tabernacles on the earth.
live_here: And he built booths for himself and for his servants on this festival, and he was the first to celebrate the feast of tabernacles on the earth.
live_proposed: And he built booths for himself and for his servants on this festival, and he was the first to celebrate the feast of tabernacles on the earth.
note: Jubilees 16:21 — *And he built booths for himself and for his servants on this festival, and he was the first to celebrate the feast of tabernacles on the earth.* Two chapters back Abraham already kept the seven-day feast before Sinai — the festival ordained on the heavenly tables in Jubilees 18:19 is no late invention but a patriarch's practice.

live_here: And the prince of the Mastêmâ was put to shame; and Abraham lifted up his eyes and looked, and, behold, a single ram caught … by his horns, and Abraham went and took the ram and offered it for a burnt-offering in the stead of his son.
live_proposed: And the prince of the Mastêmâ was put to shame; and Abraham lifted up his eyes and looked, and, behold, a single ram caught … by his horns, and Abraham went and took the ram and offered it for a burnt-offering in the stead of his son.
note: Jubilees 18:12 — *And the prince of the Mastêmâ was put to shame; and Abraham lifted up his eyes and looked, and, behold, a single ram caught … by his horns.* The Mastema who shall not rule over Jacob's seed in 19:28 is the same accuser shamed at the altar one chapter back.

note: Jubilees 18:12 — *And the prince of the Mastêmâ was put to shame; and Abraham lifted up his eyes and looked, and, behold, a single ram caught … by his horns.* The tenth trial of 19:8 stands in line with the Akedah of the chapter before — Abraham tested and found faithful, the satan shamed.

quote: Be you ware, my son Jacob, of taking a wife from any seed of the daughters of Canaan; For all his seed is to be rooted out of the earth.

note: Jubilees 22:20 — *Be you ware, my son Jacob, of taking a wife from any seed of the daughters of Canaan; For all his seed is to be rooted out of the earth.* Abraham repeats to Jacob the very ban he lays on all his sons here in Jubilees 20:4 — the seed kept separate runs through the whole book.

quote: Whoso sheds man's blood by man shall his blood be shed; for in the image of Elohim (God) made He man.

live_proposed: Whoso sheds man’s blood by man shall his blood be shed; for in the image of Elohim (God) made He man.
note: Jubilees 6:8 — *Whoso sheds man's blood by man shall his blood be shed; for in the image of Elohim (God) made He man.* The law Abraham presses on Isaac is the same word Jubilees records was given to Noah — the seamless witness across the patriarchs.

quote: And Noah and his sons swore that they would not eat any blood that was in any flesh, and he made a covenant before Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) for ever throughout all the generations of the earth in this month.
live_here: And Noah and his sons swore that they would not eat any blood that was in any flesh, and he made a covenant before Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) for ever throughout all the generations of the earth in this month.
live_proposed: And Noah and his sons swore that they would not eat any blood that was in any flesh, and he made a covenant before Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) for ever throughout all the generations of the earth in this month.
note: Jubilees 6:10 — *And Noah and his sons swore that they would not eat any blood that was in any flesh, and he made a covenant before Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) for ever throughout all the generations of the earth in this month.* Abraham's blood-law to Isaac descends from the everlasting covenant Noah swore — it ain't new even to the patriarchs.

quote: For I know that Yahuah (God) will choose him to be a people for possession to Himself, above all peoples that are upon the face of the earth.

note: Jubilees 19:18 — *For I know that Yahuah (God) will choose him to be a people for possession to Himself, above all peoples that are upon the face of the earth.* The Philistine curse of Jubilees 24:26 stands to guard the chosen seed — the election of Jacob Abraham already foresaw.

quote: Be you ware, my son Jacob, of taking a wife from any seed of the daughters of Canaan; For all his seed is to be rooted out of the earth.
live_here: Be you ware, my son Jacob, of taking a wife from any seed of the daughters of Canaan; For all his seed is to be rooted out of the earth.

note: Jubilees 22:20 — *Be you ware, my son Jacob, of taking a wife from any seed of the daughters of Canaan; For all his seed is to be rooted out of the earth.* Abraham's command spoken to Jacob by name in earlier Jubilees, here remembered in Jubilees 25:5.

quote: and let them not take to themselves wives from the daughters of Canaan; for the seed of Canaan will be rooted out of the land.
live_here: And if any woman or maid commit fornication amongst you, burn her with fire, and let them not commit fornication with her after their eyes and their heart; and let them not take to themselves wives from the daughters of Canaan; for the seed of Canaan will be rooted out of the land.

note: Jubilees 20:4 — *and let them not take to themselves wives from the daughters of Canaan; for the seed of Canaan will be rooted out of the land.* Jubilees' own earlier record of the many commands Abraham gave, which Jacob recalls in Jubilees 25:6.

quote: And Jacob said to him: “Sell to me your primogeniture, this birthright and I will give you bread, and also some of this lentil pottage.”

note: Jubilees 24:3 — *And Jacob said to him: “Sell to me your primogeniture, this birthright and I will give you bread, and also some of this lentil pottage.”* The birthright Esau mourns losing in Jubilees 26:29 he had already sold for pottage in Jubilees' earlier telling.

note: Jubilees 30:11 — *And do you, Moses, command the children of Yashar’el (Israel) and exhort them not to give their daughters to the nations, and not to take for their sons any of the daughters of the nations, for this is abominable before Yahuah (God).* Jubilees' own self-witness that the seed is kept holy — the covenant-line preserved, the same principle Rebecca pleads in 27:8.

quote: ...and of all that you give me, I shall give the tenth to you, my Elohim (God).
live_here: And Jacob vowed a vow to Yahuah (God), saying: “If Yahuah (God) will be with me, and will keep me in this way that I go, and give me bread to eat and raiment to put on, so that I come again to my father’s house in peace, then shall Yahuah (God) be my Elohim (God), and this stone which I have set up as a pillar for a sign in this place, shall be Yahuah (God)’s house, and of all that you give me, I shall give the tenth to you, my Elohim (God).”
live_proposed: And Jacob vowed a vow to Yahuah (God), saying: “If Yahuah (God) will be with me, and will keep me in this way that I go, and give me bread to eat and raiment to put on, so that I come again to my father’s house in peace, then shall Yahuah (God) be my Elohim (God), and this stone which I have set up as a pillar for a sign in this place, shall be Yahuah (God)’s house, and of all that you give me, I shall give the tenth to you, my Elohim (God).”

live_proposed: And do you, my son, observe His commandments and His ordinances and His judgments, and walk not after the abominations and after the graven images and after the molten images.
note: Jubilees 21:5 — *And do you, my son, observe His commandments and His ordinances and His judgments, and walk not after the abominations and after the graven images and after the molten images.* Abraham's testament to Isaac is the same charge Isaac now passes to his sons in Jubilees 36:5.

quote: And if either of you devises evil against his brother, know that from henceforth every one that devises evil against his brother will fall into his hand, and will be rooted out of the land of the living, and his seed will be destroyed from under heaven.
live_here: And if either of you devises evil against his brother, know that from henceforth every one that devises evil against his brother will fall into his hand, and will be rooted out of the land of the living, and his seed will be destroyed from under heaven.
live_proposed: And if either of you devises evil against his brother, know that from henceforth every one that devises evil against his brother will fall into his hand, and will be rooted out of the land of the living, and his seed will be destroyed from under heaven.
note: Jubilees 36:9 — *And if either of you devises evil against his brother, know that from henceforth every one that devises evil against his brother will fall into his hand, and will be rooted out of the land of the living, and his seed will be destroyed from under heaven.* Esau's sons devise the very evil (Jubilees 37:5) Isaac's oath cursed with rooting-out.

quote: And that each will love his brother with affection and righteousness, and that neither will desire evil against his brother from henceforth for ever all the days of your life, so that you may prosper in all your deeds and not be destroyed.
live_here: And that each will love his brother with affection and righteousness, and that neither will desire evil against his brother from henceforth for ever all the days of your life, so that you may prosper in all your deeds and not be destroyed.

quote: And the Egyptian saw the garment of Joseph and the broken door, and heard the words of his wife, and cast Joseph into prison… and Yahuah (God) gave Joseph favour in the sight of the chief of the prison guards and compassion before him, for he saw that Yahuah (God) was with him, and that Yahuah (God) made all that he did to prosper.
live_here: And he was there in the prison; and Yahuah (God) gave Joseph favour in the sight of the chief of the prison guards and compassion before him, for he saw that Yahuah (God) was with him, and that Yahuah (God) made all that he did to prosper.
live_proposed: And he was there in the prison; and Yahuah (God) gave Joseph favour in the sight of the chief of the prison guards and compassion before him, for he saw that Yahuah (God) was with him, and that Yahuah (God) made all that he did to prosper.
note: Jubilees 39:12 — *And the Egyptian saw the garment of Joseph and the broken door, and heard the words of his wife, and cast Joseph into prison… and Yahuah (God) gave Joseph favour in the sight of the chief of the prison guards and compassion before him, for he saw that Yahuah (God) was with him, and that Yahuah (God) made all that he did to prosper.* The upright Joseph of Jubilees 40:8 is the same man who kept his purity in Jubilees 39:12 — “Yahuah was with him” ties the pit to the throne.

quote: And in the seventh year of this week he sent Joseph to learn about the welfare of his brothers from his house to the land of Shechem, and he found them in the land of Dothan
live_here: And in the seventh year of this week he sent Joseph to learn about the welfare of his brothers from his house to the land of Shechem, and he found them in the land of Dothan.
live_proposed: And in the seventh year of this week he sent Joseph to learn about the welfare of his brothers from his house to the land of Shechem, and he found them in the land of Dothan.
note: Jubilees 34:10 — *And in the seventh year of this week he sent Joseph to learn about the welfare of his brothers from his house to the land of Shechem, and he found them in the land of Dothan* — the earlier Jubilees account of Joseph sent to the brothers who would sell him, now exalted in Jubilees 43:19.

quote: And in the forty-fifth jubilee, in the second week, (and) in the second year, Yahudah (Judah) took for his first-born Er, a wife from the daughters of Aram, named Tamar.
live_here: And in the forty-fifth jubilee, in the second week, (and) in the second year, Yahudah (Judah) took for his first-born Er, a wife from the daughters of Aram, named Tamar.
live_proposed: And in the forty-fifth jubilee, in the second week, (and) in the second year, Yahudah (Judah) took for his first-born Er, a wife from the daughters of Aram, named Tamar.
note: Jubilees 41:1 — *And in the forty-fifth jubilee, in the second week, (and) in the second year, Yahudah (Judah) took for his first-born Er, a wife from the daughters of Aram, named Tamar.* Jubilees' own earlier telling of the Er-and-Tamar story behind the deaths noted in Jubilees 44:34 — the Tamar-Perez chapter that secured the line.

quote: And behold, I shall be with you, and shall keep you whithersoever you go, and I shall bring you again into this land in peace; for I shall not leave you until I do everything that I told you of.
live_here: And behold, I shall be with you, and shall keep you whithersoever you go, and I shall bring you again into this land in peace; for I shall not leave you until I do everything that I told you of.”
live_proposed: And behold, I shall be with you, and shall keep you whithersoever you go, and I shall bring you again into this land in peace; for I shall not leave you until I do everything that I told you of.”
note: Jubilees 27:24 — *And behold, I shall be with you, and shall keep you whithersoever you go, and I shall bring you again into this land in peace; for I shall not leave you until I do everything that I told you of.* The Bethel dream Jacob 'remembered' in Jubilees 44:2 — the same 'I shall bring you again' that steadies him now.

quote: And he turned to Levi first, and began to bless him first, and said to him:, ’May the Elohim (God) of all, the very Yahuah (God) of all the ages, bless you and your children throughout all the ages. And may Yahuah (God) give to you and to your seed greatness and great glory, and cause you and your seed, from among all flesh, to approach Him to serve in His sanctuary as the angels of the presence and as the holy ones.
live_here: And he turned to Levi first, and began to bless him first, and said to him:, ’May the Elohim (God) of all, the very Yahuah (God) of all the ages, bless you and your children throughout all the ages.
live_proposed: And he turned to Levi first, and began to bless him first, and said to him:, ’May the Elohim (God) of all, the very Yahuah (God) of all the ages, bless you and your children throughout all the ages.
note: Jubilees 31:13 — *And he turned to Levi first, and began to bless him first, and said to him:, ’May the Elohim (God) of all, the very Yahuah (God) of all the ages, bless you and your children throughout all the ages. And may Yahuah (God) give to you and to your seed greatness and great glory, and cause you and your seed, from among all flesh, to approach Him to serve in His sanctuary as the angels of the presence and as the holy ones.* Jubilees 45:15 entrusts the books to Levi — the very priestly line Isaac blessed to serve in the sanctuary.

quote: For on this night–the beginning of the festival and the beginning of the joy–you were eating the passover in Egypt, when all the powers of Mastêmâ had been let loose to slay all the first-born in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh to the first-born of the captive maidservant in the mill, and to the cattle.
live_here: For on this night–the beginning of the festival and the beginning of the joy–you were eating the passover in Egypt, when all the powers of Mastêmâ had been let loose to slay all the first-born in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh to the first-born of the captive maidservant in the mill, and to the cattle.
live_proposed: For on this night–the beginning of the festival and the beginning of the joy–you were eating the passover in Egypt, when all the powers of Mastêmâ had been let loose to slay all the first-born in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh to the first-born of the captive maidservant in the mill, and to the cattle.
note: Jubilees 49:2 — *For on this night–the beginning of the festival and the beginning of the joy–you were eating the passover in Egypt, when all the powers of Mastêmâ had been let loose to slay all the first-born in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh to the first-born of the captive maidservant in the mill, and to the cattle.* The next chapter ties the tenth of these ten judgments (Jubilees 48:7) to the eternal Passover night.

quote: And He said to us: “Behold, I will separate to Myself a people from among all the peoples, and these will keep the Sabbath day, and I will sanctify them to Myself as My people, and will bless them...
live_here: And He said to us: “Behold, I will separate to Myself a people from among all the peoples, and these will keep the Sabbath day, and I will sanctify them to Myself as My people, and will bless them; as I have sanctified the Sabbath day and do sanctify (it) to Myself, even so shall I bless them, and they will be My people and I shall be their Elohim (God).
live_proposed: And He said to us: “Behold, I will separate to Myself a people from among all the peoples, and these will keep the Sabbath day, and I will sanctify them to Myself as My people, and will bless them; as I have sanctified the Sabbath day and do sanctify (it) to Myself, even so shall I bless them, and they will be My people and I shall be their Elohim (God).
note: Jubilees 2:19 — *And He said to us: “Behold, I will separate to Myself a people from among all the peoples, and these will keep the Sabbath day, and I will sanctify them to Myself as My people, and will bless them...* The book that closes on the Sabbath 'for ever' opened on this same heavenly Sabbath — the inclusio of the whole Book of Division.

quote: And Yahuah our Elohim (the LORD our God) caused a deep sleep to fall upon him, and he slept, and He took for the woman one rib from amongst his ribs, and this rib was the origin of the woman from amongst his ribs, and He built up the flesh in its stead, and built the woman.
live_here: And Yahuah our Elohim (the LORD our God) caused a deep sleep to fall upon him, and he slept, and He took for the woman one rib from amongst his ribs, and this rib was the origin of the woman from amongst his ribs, and He built up the flesh in its stead, and built the woman.
live_proposed: And Yahuah our Elohim (the LORD our God) caused a deep sleep to fall upon him, and he slept, and He took for the woman one rib from amongst his ribs, and this rib was the origin of the woman from amongst his ribs, and He built up the flesh in its stead, and built the woman.
note: Jubilees 3:5 — *And Yahuah our Elohim (the LORD our God) caused a deep sleep to fall upon him, and he slept, and He took for the woman one rib from amongst his ribs, and this rib was the origin of the woman from amongst his ribs, and He built up the flesh in its stead, and built the woman.* Jubilees narrates the same forming of the woman as Jasher 1:4 — the now-live witness beside it.

quote: And in the third week in the second jubilee she gave birth to Cain, and in the fourth she gave birth to Abel, and in the fifth she gave birth to her daughter 'Âwân.
live_here: And in the third week in the second jubilee she gave birth to Cain, and in the fourth she gave birth to Abel, and in the fifth she gave birth to her daughter ’Âwân.
live_proposed: And in the third week in the second jubilee she gave birth to Cain, and in the fourth she gave birth to Abel, and in the fifth she gave birth to her daughter ’Âwân.
note: Jubilees 4:1 — *And in the third week in the second jubilee she gave birth to Cain, and in the fourth she gave birth to Abel, and in the fifth she gave birth to her daughter 'Âwân.* Jubilees records the same first births Jasher 1:13 names — the now-live patriarchal witness, dated in jubilees.

quote: And in the first (year) of the third jubilee, Cain slew Abel because Elohim (God) accepted the sacrifice of Abel, and did not accept the offering of Cain.
live_here: And in the first (year) of the third jubilee, Cain slew Abel because Elohim (God) accepted the sacrifice of Abel, and did not accept the offering of Cain.
live_proposed: And in the first (year) of the third jubilee, Cain slew Abel because Elohim (God) accepted the sacrifice of Abel, and did not accept the offering of Cain.
note: Jubilees 4:2 — *And in the first (year) of the third jubilee, Cain slew Abel because Elohim (God) accepted the sacrifice of Abel, and did not accept the offering of Cain.* Jubilees names the rejected offering of Jasher 1:16 as the very cause of the murder to come — the now-live witness beside it.

quote: And he slew him in the field: and his blood cried from the ground to heaven, complaining because he had slain him.
live_here: And he slew him in the field: and his blood cried from the ground to heaven, complaining because he had slain him.
live_proposed: And he slew him in the field: and his blood cried from the ground to heaven, complaining because he had slain him.
note: Jubilees 4:3 — *And he slew him in the field: and his blood cried from the ground to heaven, complaining because he had slain him.* Jubilees tells the same field-murder of Jasher 1:25, with Abel's blood crying from the ground — the now-live patriarchal witness.

quote: And Yahuah (God) reproved Cain because of Abel, because he had slain him, and he made him a fugitive on the earth because of the blood of his brother, and he cursed him upon the earth...
live_here: And Yahuah (God) reproved Cain because of Abel, because he had slain him, and he made him a fugitive on the earth because of the blood of his brother, and he cursed him upon the earth.
live_proposed: And Yahuah (God) reproved Cain because of Abel, because he had slain him, and he made him a fugitive on the earth because of the blood of his brother, and he cursed him upon the earth.
note: Jubilees 4:4 — *And Yahuah (God) reproved Cain because of Abel, because he had slain him, and he made him a fugitive on the earth because of the blood of his brother, and he cursed him upon the earth...* Jubilees gives the same curse and fugitive-sentence Jasher 1:31 records — the now-live witness, adding the heavenly-tables verdict on treacherous murder.

quote: At the close of this jubilee Cain was killed after him in the same year; for his house fell upon him and he died in the midst of his house, and he was killed by its stones, for with a stone he had killed Abel, and by a stone was he killed in righteous judgment.
live_here: At the close of this jubilee Cain was killed after him in the same year; for his house fell upon him and he died in the midst of his house, and he was killed by its stones, for with a stone he had killed Abel, and by a stone was he killed in righteous judgment.
live_proposed: At the close of this jubilee Cain was killed after him in the same year; for his house fell upon him and he died in the midst of his house, and he was killed by its stones, for with a stone he had killed Abel, and by a stone was he killed in righteous judgment.
note: Jubilees 4:31 — *At the close of this jubilee Cain was killed after him in the same year; for his house fell upon him and he died in the midst of his house, and he was killed by its stones, for with a stone he had killed Abel, and by a stone was he killed in righteous judgment.* Jubilees follows the same Cain whose city Jasher 1:35 builds to his stone-struck end in righteous judgment — the now-live witness.

quote: Mahalalel took to him to wife Dînâh, the daughter of Barâkî'êl the daughter of his father's brother, and she bare him a son... and he called his name Jared; for in his days the angels of Yahuah (God) descended on the earth, those who are named the Watchers, that they should instruct the children of men.
live_here: And in the second week of the tenth jubilee Mahalalel took to him to wife Dînâh, the daughter of Barâkî’êl the daughter of his father’s brother, and she bare him a son in the third week in the sixth year, and he called his name Jared; for in his days the angels of Yahuah (God) descended on the earth, those who are named the Watchers, that they should instruct the children of men, and that they should do judgment and uprightness on the earth.
live_proposed: And in the second week of the tenth jubilee Mahalalel took to him to wife Dînâh, the daughter of Barâkî’êl the daughter of his father’s brother, and she bare him a son in the third week in the sixth year, and he called his name Jared; for in his days the angels of Yahuah (God) descended on the earth, those who are named the Watchers, that they should instruct the children of men, and that they should do judgment and uprightness on the earth.
note: Jubilees 4:15 — *Mahalalel took to him to wife Dînâh, the daughter of Barâkî'êl the daughter of his father's brother, and she bare him a son... and he called his name Jared; for in his days the angels of Yahuah (God) descended on the earth, those who are named the Watchers, that they should instruct the children of men.* Jubilees carries the same Mahalaleel-Jared generation of Jasher 2:37 and marks Jared's days as when the Watchers came down — the corruption Jasher's next chapters and 1 Enoch unfold.

quote: Cain was killed after him in the same year; for his house fell upon him and he died in the midst of his house, and he was killed by its stones, for with a stone he had killed Abel, and by a stone was he killed in righteous judgment.
live_here: At the close of this jubilee Cain was killed after him in the same year; for his house fell upon him and he died in the midst of his house, and he was killed by its stones, for with a stone he had killed Abel, and by a stone was he killed in righteous judgment.
live_proposed: At the close of this jubilee Cain was killed after him in the same year; for his house fell upon him and he died in the midst of his house, and he was killed by its stones, for with a stone he had killed Abel, and by a stone was he killed in righteous judgment.
note: Jubilees 4:31 — *Cain was killed after him in the same year; for his house fell upon him and he died in the midst of his house, and he was killed by its stones, for with a stone he had killed Abel, and by a stone was he killed in righteous judgment.* Both Jasher 2:29 and Jubilees end Cain in measure-for-measure judgment for Abel's blood — the same event, both now live.

quote: And he was the first among men that are born on earth who learnt writing and knowledge and wisdom and who wrote down the signs of heaven according to the order of their months in a book, that men might know the seasons of the years according to the order of their separate months.
live_here: And he was the first among men that are born on earth who learnt writing and knowledge and wisdom and who wrote down the signs of heaven according to the order of their months in a book, that men might know the seasons of the years according to the order of their separate months.
live_proposed: And he was the first among men that are born on earth who learnt writing and knowledge and wisdom and who wrote down the signs of heaven according to the order of their months in a book, that men might know the seasons of the years according to the order of their separate months.
note: Jubilees 4:17 — *And he was the first among men that are born on earth who learnt writing and knowledge and wisdom and who wrote down the signs of heaven according to the order of their months in a book, that men might know the seasons of the years according to the order of their separate months.* Cainan's writing of things to come on stone tablets in Jasher 2:13 mirrors the chosen line's scribal foreknowledge that Jubilees gives to Enoch.

quote: Adam knew his wife again, and she bare him a son, and he called his name Seth; for he said "Elohim (God) has raised up a second seed to us on the earth instead of Abel; for Cain slew him."
live_here: And Adam and his wife mourned for Abel four weeks of years, and in the fourth year of the fifth week they became joyful, and Adam knew his wife again, and she bare him a son, and he called his name Seth; for he said “Elohim (God) has raised up a second seed to us on the earth instead of Abel; for Cain slew him.”
live_proposed: And Adam and his wife mourned for Abel four weeks of years, and in the fourth year of the fifth week they became joyful, and Adam knew his wife again, and she bare him a son, and he called his name Seth; for he said “Elohim (God) has raised up a second seed to us on the earth instead of Abel; for Cain slew him.”
note: Jubilees 4:7 — *Adam knew his wife again, and she bare him a son, and he called his name Seth; for he said "Elohim (God) has raised up a second seed to us on the earth instead of Abel; for Cain slew him."* Jubilees narrates the identical appointed-seed scene of Jasher 2:1 — both now live, the same election.

quote: And in the eleventh jubilee Jared took to himself a wife... and she bare him a son in the fifth week, in the fourth year of the jubilee, and he called his name Enoch.
live_here: And in the eleventh jubilee Jared took to himself a wife, and her name was Bâraka, the daughter of Râsûjâl, a daughter of his father’s brother, in the fourth week of this jubilee, and she bare him a son in the fifth week, in the fourth year of the jubilee, and he called his name Enoch.
live_proposed: And in the eleventh jubilee Jared took to himself a wife, and her name was Bâraka, the daughter of Râsûjâl, a daughter of his father’s brother, in the fourth week of this jubilee, and she bare him a son in the fifth week, in the fourth year of the jubilee, and he called his name Enoch.
note: Jubilees 4:16 — *And in the eleventh jubilee Jared took to himself a wife... and she bare him a son in the fifth week, in the fourth year of the jubilee, and he called his name Enoch.* the same patriarchal birth Jasher 3:1 records, both tracing the seed-line generation by generation.

quote: And he was the first among men that are born on earth who learnt writing and knowledge and wisdom... And he was the first to write a testimony, and he testified to the sons of men among the generations of the earth
live_here: And he was the first among men that are born on earth who learnt writing and knowledge and wisdom and who wrote down the signs of heaven according to the order of their months in a book, that men might know the seasons of the years according to the order of their separate months.
live_proposed: And he was the first among men that are born on earth who learnt writing and knowledge and wisdom and who wrote down the signs of heaven according to the order of their months in a book, that men might know the seasons of the years according to the order of their separate months.
note: Jubilees 4:17 — *And he was the first among men that are born on earth who learnt writing and knowledge and wisdom... And he was the first to write a testimony, and he testified to the sons of men among the generations of the earth* the wisdom Jasher 3:8 says the spirit of Elohim gave Enoch to teach all his men.

quote: And he lacked seventy years of one thousand years; for one thousand years are as one day in the testimony of the heavens and therefore was it written concerning the tree of knowledge: "On the day that you eat thereof you will die."
live_here: And he lacked seventy years of one thousand years; for one thousand years are as one day in the testimony of the heavens and therefore was it written concerning the tree of knowledge: “On the day that you eat thereof you will die.” For this reason he did not complete the years of this day; for he died during it.
live_proposed: And he lacked seventy years of one thousand years; for one thousand years are as one day in the testimony of the heavens and therefore was it written concerning the tree of knowledge: “On the day that you eat thereof you will die.” For this reason he did not complete the years of this day; for he died during it.
note: Jubilees 4:30 — *And he lacked seventy years of one thousand years; for one thousand years are as one day in the testimony of the heavens and therefore was it written concerning the tree of knowledge: "On the day that you eat thereof you will die."* the very tree-of-knowledge death Jasher 3:16 names as the cause of Adam's dying.

quote: And at the close of the nineteenth jubilee... Adam died, and all his sons buried him in the land of his creation, and he was the first to be buried in the earth.
live_here: And at the close of the nineteenth jubilee, in the seventh week in the sixth year thereof, Adam died, and all his sons buried him in the land of his creation, and he was the first to be buried in the earth.
live_proposed: And at the close of the nineteenth jubilee, in the seventh week in the sixth year thereof, Adam died, and all his sons buried him in the land of his creation, and he was the first to be buried in the earth.
note: Jubilees 4:29 — *And at the close of the nineteenth jubilee... Adam died, and all his sons buried him in the land of his creation, and he was the first to be buried in the earth.* the burial Jasher 3:14 records with Enoch and Methuselah laying Adam in the cave with great pomp.

quote: And he was taken from amongst the children of men, and we conducted him into the Garden of Eden in majesty and honour, and behold there he writes down the condemnation and judgment of the world
live_here: And he was taken from amongst the children of men, and we conducted him into the Garden of Eden in majesty and honour, and behold there he writes down the condemnation and judgment of the world, and all the wickedness of the children of men.
live_proposed: And he was taken from amongst the children of men, and we conducted him into the Garden of Eden in majesty and honour, and behold there he writes down the condemnation and judgment of the world, and all the wickedness of the children of men.
note: Jubilees 4:23 — *And he was taken from amongst the children of men, and we conducted him into the Garden of Eden in majesty and honour, and behold there he writes down the condemnation and judgment of the world* the taking-up Jasher 3:23 sets in motion when the angel calls Enoch to reign in heaven.

quote: And what was and what will be he saw in a vision of his sleep... he saw and understood everything, and wrote his testimony, and placed the testimony on earth for all the children of men and for their generations.
live_here: And what was and what will be he saw in a vision of his sleep, as it will happen to the children of men throughout their generations until the day of judgment; he saw and understood everything, and wrote his testimony, and placed the testimony on earth for all the children of men and for their generations.
live_proposed: And what was and what will be he saw in a vision of his sleep, as it will happen to the children of men throughout their generations until the day of judgment; he saw and understood everything, and wrote his testimony, and placed the testimony on earth for all the children of men and for their generations.
note: Jubilees 4:19 — *And what was and what will be he saw in a vision of his sleep... he saw and understood everything, and wrote his testimony, and placed the testimony on earth for all the children of men and for their generations.* the parting wisdom Jasher 3:25 has Enoch leave so the sons of men may live.

quote: he was set as a sign and that he should testify against all the children of men, that he should recount all the deeds of the generations until the day of condemnation.
live_here: And on account of it Elohim (God) brought the waters of the flood upon all the land of Eden; for there he was set as a sign and that he should testify against all the children of men, that he should recount all the deeds of the generations until the day of condemnation.
live_proposed: And on account of it Elohim (God) brought the waters of the flood upon all the land of Eden; for there he was set as a sign and that he should testify against all the children of men, that he should recount all the deeds of the generations until the day of condemnation.
note: Jubilees 4:24 — *he was set as a sign and that he should testify against all the children of men, that he should recount all the deeds of the generations until the day of condemnation.* the witness-to-the-generations role behind Jasher 3:31, where Enoch's last day teaching bids all men serve Yahuah and walk in his ways.

quote: But Noah found grace before the eyes of Yahuah (God).
live_here: But Noah found grace before the eyes of Yahuah (God).
live_proposed: But Noah found grace before the eyes of Yahuah (God).
note: Jubilees 5:5 — *But Noah found grace before the eyes of Yahuah (God).* The same election of Noah out of the doomed world that Jasher 4:21 declares.

quote: And lawlessness increased on the earth and all flesh corrupted its way, alike men and cattle and beasts and birds and everything that walks on the earth...
live_here: And lawlessness increased on the earth and all flesh corrupted its way, alike men and cattle and beasts and birds and everything that walks on the earth-all of them corrupted their ways and their orders, and they began to devour each other, and lawlessness increased on the earth and every imagination of the thoughts of all men (was) thus evil continually.
live_proposed: And lawlessness increased on the earth and all flesh corrupted its way, alike men and cattle and beasts and birds and everything that walks on the earth-all of them corrupted their ways and their orders, and they began to devour each other, and lawlessness increased on the earth and every imagination of the thoughts of all men (was) thus evil continually.

live_proposed: And Abraham took to himself a third wife, and her name was Keturah, from among the daughters of his household servants, for Hagar had died before Sarah.

And she bare him six sons, Zimram, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah, in the two weeks of years.* The same Keturah-and-six-sons scene in the parallel patriarchal record beside Jasher 25:2.

quote: My daughter, watch over my son Jacob, For he shall be in my stead on the earth, And for a blessing in the midst of the children of men, And for the glory of the whole seed of Shem. For I know that Yahuah (God) will choose him to be a people for possession to Himself, above all peoples that are upon the face of the earth.

For I know that Yahuah (God) will choose him to be a people for possession to Himself, above all peoples that are upon the face of the earth.* Where Jasher 26:28 has Abraham bless Isaac and teach Jacob the way of Yahuah, Jubilees fixes the election squarely on Jacob as the chosen seed.

quote: And it came to pass in the first week in the forty-fourth jubilee, in the second year, that is, the year in which Abraham died, that Isaac and Ishmael came from the Well of the Oath to celebrate the feast of weeks... to Abraham, their father, and Abraham rejoiced because his two sons had come.

live_proposed: And it came to pass in the first week in the forty-fourth jubilee, in the second year, that is, the year in which Abraham died, that Isaac and Ishmael came from the Well of the Oath to celebrate the feast of weeks–that is, the feast of the first-fruits of the harvest–to Abraham, their father, and Abraham rejoiced because his two sons had come.

quote: And the youths grew, and Jacob learned to write; but Esau did not learn, for he was a man of the field and a hunter, and he learnt war, and all his deeds were fierce. And Abraham loved Jacob, but Isaac loved Esau.

quote: And in the sixth week, in the second year thereof, Rebecca bare to Isaac two sons, Jacob and Esau, and Jacob was a smooth and upright man, and Esau was fierce, a man of the field, and hairy, and Jacob dwelt in tents.

quote: And Esau said in his heart: “I shall die; of what profit to me is this birthright?” And he said to Jacob: “I give it to you.”

quote: And he sowed in the land of the Philistines and brought in a hundred-fold, and Isaac became exceedingly great, and the Philistines envied him.

quote: And in the first year of the fourth week a famine began in the land, besides the first famine, which had been in the days of Abraham.
live_here: And in the first year of the fourth week a famine began in the land, besides the first famine, which had been in the days of Abraham.

quote: And El Shaddai (God Almighty) bless you and increase and multiply you that you may become a company of nations, and give you the blessings of my father Abraham, to you and to your seed after you, that you may inherit the land of your sojournings and all the land which Elohim (God) gave to Abraham: go, my son, in peace.
live_here: And El Shaddai (God Almighty) bless you and increase and multiply you that you may become a company of nations, and give you the blessings of my father Abraham, to you and to your seed after you, that you may inherit the land of your sojournings and all the land which Elohim (God) gave to Abraham: go, my son, in peace.”

quote: Now, therefore, my son, obey my voice, and arise and flee you to Laban, my brother, to Haran, and tarry with him a few days until your brother’s anger turns away, and he remove his anger from you, and forget all that you have done; then I will send and fetch you from thence.

live_proposed: Now, therefore, my son, obey my voice, and arise and flee you to Laban, my brother, to Haran, and tarry with him a few days until your brother’s anger turns away, and he remove his anger from you, and forget all that you have done; then I will send and fetch you from thence.”
note: Jubilees 27:3 — *Now, therefore, my son, obey my voice, and arise and flee you to Laban, my brother, to Haran, and tarry with him a few days until your brother’s anger turns away, and he remove his anger from you, and forget all that you have done; then I will send and fetch you from thence.* The Jubilees telling of Rebecca's same charge to flee to Haran, paralleling Jasher 29:23.

quote: And Jacob went in to his father and said: “I am your son: I have done according as you bade me: arise and sit and eat of that which I have caught, father, that your soul may bless me.”

quote: For in the days when Jacob went to Mesopotamia, Esau took to himself a wife Mahalath, the daughter of Ishmael, and he gathered together all the flocks of his father and his wives, and went up and dwelt on Mount Seir, and left Isaac his father at the Well of the Oath alone.
live_here: For in the days when Jacob went to Mesopotamia, Esau took to himself a wife Mahalath, the daughter of Ishmael, and he gathered together all the flocks of his father and his wives, and went up and dwelt on Mount Seir, and left Isaac his father at the Well of the Oath alone.
live_proposed: For in the days when Jacob went to Mesopotamia, Esau took to himself a wife Mahalath, the daughter of Ishmael, and he gathered together all the flocks of his father and his wives, and went up and dwelt on Mount Seir, and left Isaac his father at the Well of the Oath alone.
note: Jubilees 29:18 — *For in the days when Jacob went to Mesopotamia, Esau took to himself a wife Mahalath, the daughter of Ishmael, and he gathered together all the flocks of his father and his wives, and went up and dwelt on Mount Seir, and left Isaac his father at the Well of the Oath alone.* Jubilees sets Esau's move to Seir in the same span Jasher 30:27 does — while Jacob serves Laban.

quote: And he went on his journey, and came to the land of the east, to Laban, the brother of Rebecca, and he was with him, and served him for Rachel his daughter one week.
live_here: And he went on his journey, and came to the land of the east, to Laban, the brother of Rebecca, and he was with him, and served him for Rachel his daughter one week.
live_proposed: And he went on his journey, and came to the land of the east, to Laban, the brother of Rebecca, and he was with him, and served him for Rachel his daughter one week.
note: Jubilees 28:1 — *And he went on his journey, and came to the land of the east, to Laban, the brother of Rebecca, and he was with him, and served him for Rachel his daughter one week.* Jubilees narrates the same service-for-Rachel that Jasher 30:14 sets at seven years.

quote: And he dreamt that night, and behold a ladder set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to heaven, and behold, the angels of Yahuah (God) ascended and descended on it: and behold, Yahuah (God) stood upon it...
live_here: And he dreamt that night, and behold a ladder set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to heaven, and behold, the angels of Yahuah (God) ascended and descended on it: and behold, Yahuah (God) stood upon it.

note: Jubilees 27:21 — *And he dreamt that night, and behold a ladder set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to heaven, and behold, the angels of Yahuah (God) ascended and descended on it: and behold, Yahuah (God) stood upon it...* Jubilees narrates the identical Bethel night that Jasher 30:1-3 retells.

quote: And he went in to her, and behold, she was Leah; and Jacob was angry with Laban, and said to him: “Why have you dealt thus with me? Did not I serve you for Rachel and not for Leah?

live_proposed: And he went in to her, and behold, she was Leah; and Jacob was angry with Laban, and said to him: “Why have you dealt thus with me? Did not I serve you for Rachel and not for Leah? Why have you wronged me? Take your daughter, and I will go; for you have done evil to me.”
note: Jubilees 28:4 — *And he went in to her, and behold, she was Leah; and Jacob was angry with Laban, and said to him: “Why have you dealt thus with me? Did not I serve you for Rachel and not for Leah?* Jubilees narrates the same deceived wedding night that Jasher 31:4 tells, the two extra-canon witnesses agreeing with Genesis.

quote: And Yahuah (God) opened the womb of Leah, and she conceived and bare Jacob a son, and he called his name Reuben, on the fourteenth day of the ninth month, in the first year of the third week.
live_here: And Yahuah (God) opened the womb of Leah, and she conceived and bare Jacob a son, and he called his name Reuben, on the fourteenth day of the ninth month, in the first year of the third week.
live_proposed: And Yahuah (God) opened the womb of Leah, and she conceived and bare Jacob a son, and he called his name Reuben, on the fourteenth day of the ninth month, in the first year of the third week.
note: Jubilees 28:11 — *And Yahuah (God) opened the womb of Leah, and she conceived and bare Jacob a son, and he called his name Reuben, on the fourteenth day of the ninth month, in the first year of the third week.* Jubilees dates the first of the sons Jasher 31:15 lists, the same tribal beginning.

quote: And Yahuah (God) was gracious to Rachel, and opened her womb, and she conceived, and bare a son, and she called his name Joseph, on the new moon of the fourth month, in the sixth year in this fourth week.
live_here: And Yahuah (God) was gracious to Rachel, and opened her womb, and she conceived, and bare a son, and she called his name Joseph, on the new moon of the fourth month, in the sixth year in this fourth week.
live_proposed: And Yahuah (God) was gracious to Rachel, and opened her womb, and she conceived, and bare a son, and she called his name Joseph, on the new moon of the fourth month, in the sixth year in this fourth week.

quote: And Jacob's possessions multiplied exceedingly, and he possessed oxen and sheep and asses and camels, and menservants and maidservants. And Laban and his sons envied Jacob.

note: Jubilees 28:29 — *And Jacob's possessions multiplied exceedingly, and he possessed oxen and sheep and asses and camels, and menservants and maidservants. And Laban and his sons envied Jacob.* Jubilees joins the same multiplying-and-envy Jasher 31:31-35 records.

quote: And Jacob saw that Laban was going to shear his sheep, and Jacob called Leah and Rachel, and spake kindly to them that they should come with him to the land of Canaan.
live_here: And Jacob saw that Laban was going to shear his sheep, and Jacob called Leah and Rachel, and spake kindly to them that they should come with him to the land of Canaan.

quote: And he made there a heap for a witness; wherefore the name of that place is called: “The Heap of Witness,” after this heap.

live_proposed: And he passed over the Jabbok in the ninth month, on the eleventh thereof. And on that day Esau, his brother, came to him, and he was reconciled to him, and departed from him to the land of Seir, but Jacob dwelt in tents.
note: Jubilees 29:13 — *And on that day Esau, his brother, came to him, and he was reconciled to him, and departed from him to the land of Seir, but Jacob dwelt in tents.* Jasher 32:73's parting — Esau back to Seir, Jacob on to Canaan — is the same reconciliation and departure the Jubilees apparatus records.

quote: And the seed of Levi was chosen for the priesthood, and to be Levites, that they might minister before Yahuah (God), as we, continually, and that Levi and his sons may be blessed for ever; for he was zealous to execute righteousness and judgment and vengeance on all those who arose against Yashar'el (Israel).
live_here: And the seed of Levi was chosen for the priesthood, and to be Levites, that they might minister before Yahuah (God), as we, continually, and that Levi and his sons may be blessed for ever; for he was zealous to execute righteousness and judgment and vengeance on all those who arose against Yashar’el (Israel).
live_proposed: And the seed of Levi was chosen for the priesthood, and to be Levites, that they might minister before Yahuah (God), as we, continually, and that Levi and his sons may be blessed for ever; for he was zealous to execute righteousness and judgment and vengeance on all those who arose against Yashar’el (Israel).

quote: And Yahuah (God) delivered them into the hands of the sons of Jacob that they might exterminate them with the sword and execute judgment upon them, and that it might not thus again be done in Yashar'el (Israel) that a virgin of Yashar'el (Israel) should be defiled.
live_here: And Yahuah (God) delivered them into the hands of the sons of Jacob that they might exterminate them with the sword and execute judgment upon them, and that it might not thus again be done in Yashar’el (Israel) that a virgin of Yashar’el (Israel) should be defiled.
live_proposed: And Yahuah (God) delivered them into the hands of the sons of Jacob that they might exterminate them with the sword and execute judgment upon them, and that it might not thus again be done in Yashar’el (Israel) that a virgin of Yashar’el (Israel) should be defiled.
note: Jubilees 30:6 — *And Yahuah (God) delivered them into the hands of the sons of Jacob that they might exterminate them with the sword and execute judgment upon them, and that it might not thus again be done in Yashar'el (Israel) that a virgin of Yashar'el (Israel) should be defiled.* Jubilees names the same hand that Jasher 33:52 names — Yahuah delivering Shechem into the sons of Jacob.

quote: And thus let it not again be done from henceforth that a daughter of Yashar'el (Israel) be defiled; for judgment is ordained in heaven against them that they should destroy with the sword all the men of the Shechemites because they had wrought shame in Yashar'el (Israel).

live_proposed: And thus let it not again be done from henceforth that a daughter of Yashar’el (Israel) be defiled; for judgment is ordained in heaven against them that they should destroy with the sword all the men of the Shechemites because they had wrought shame in Yashar’el (Israel).
note: Jubilees 30:5 — *And thus let it not again be done from henceforth that a daughter of Yashar'el (Israel) be defiled; for judgment is ordained in heaven against them that they should destroy with the sword all the men of the Shechemites because they had wrought shame in Yashar'el (Israel).* Jubilees draws from this scene the same standing judgment Jasher 33:34 invokes against the city.

quote: And there they carried off Dinah, the daughter of Jacob, into the house of Shechem, the son of Hamor, the Hivite, the prince of the land, and he lay with her and defiled her, and she was a little girl, a child of twelve years.

note: Jubilees 30:2 — *And there they carried off Dinah, the daughter of Jacob, into the house of Shechem, the son of Hamor, the Hivite, the prince of the land, and he lay with her and defiled her, and she was a little girl, a child of twelve years.* Jubilees, like Jasher 33:11, has Dinah carried into Shechem's house and defiled.

quote: And in the first year of the sixth week he went up to Salem, to the east of Shechem, in peace, in the fourth month.
live_here: And in the first year of the sixth week he went up to Salem, to the east of Shechem, in peace, in the fourth month.
live_proposed: And in the first year of the sixth week he went up to Salem, to the east of Shechem, in peace, in the fourth month.
note: Jubilees 30:1 — *And in the first year of the sixth week he went up to Salem, to the east of Shechem, in peace, in the fourth month.* Jubilees fixes Jacob's coming to Shalem/Shechem in its calendar, the same scene Jasher 33:1 opens with.

quote: And the dread of Yahuah (God) was upon all the cities which are around about Shechem, and they did not rise to pursue after the sons of Jacob; for terror had fallen upon them.

quote: And he reproached them because they had put the city to the sword; for he feared those who dwelt in the land, the Canaanites and the Perizzites.

quote: And they brought Dinah, their sister, out of the house of Shechem, and they took captive everything that was in Shechem, their sheep and their oxen and their asses, and all their wealth, and all their flocks, and brought them all to Jacob their father.

live_proposed: And they brought Dinah, their sister, out of the house of Shechem, and they took captive everything that was in Shechem, their sheep and their oxen and their asses, and all their wealth, and all their flocks, and brought them all to Jacob their father.

quote: And Simeon and Levi came unexpectedly to Shechem and executed judgment on all the men of Shechem, and slew all the men whom they found in it, and left not a single one remaining in it: they slew all in torments because they had dishonoured their sister Dinah.

The restored witness names the scheme outright as building seed by the maid — the very word of *go in unto my maid; it may be that I may obtain children by her* (Genesis 16:2). The promised heir is sought not by waiting on Yahuah but by a plan of the flesh, the mistress reaching to manufacture the seed through her handmaid.

quote: And Abram hearkened to the voice of Sarai his wife, and said to her, "Do (so)." And Sarai took Hagar, her maid, the Egyptian, and gave her to Abram, her husband, to be his wife.
live_here: And Abram hearkened to the voice of Sarai his wife, and said to her, “Do (so).” And Sarai took Hagar, her maid, the Egyptian, and gave her to Abram, her husband, to be his wife.
live_proposed: And Abram hearkened to the voice of Sarai his wife, and said to her, “Do (so).” And Sarai took Hagar, her maid, the Egyptian, and gave her to Abram, her husband, to be his wife.
note: *And Abram hearkened to the voice of Sarai his wife, and said to her, "Do (so)." And Sarai took Hagar, her maid, the Egyptian, and gave her to Abram, her husband, to be his wife.* (Jubilees 14:23). The restored witness carries the giving verse-for-verse with *Sarai Abram's wife took Hagar her maid the Egyptian... and gave her to her husband Abram to be his wife* (Genesis 16:3) — and marks that *Abram hearkened to the voice of Sarai*, the same hearkening to the human voice rather than the divine promise.

quote: And he went in to her, and she conceived and bare him a son, and he called his name Ishmael, in the fifth year of this week; and this was the eighty-sixth year in the life of Abram.
