live_proposed: And he went in to her, and she conceived and bare him a son, and he called his name Ishmael, in the fifth year of this week; and this was the eighty-sixth year in the life of Abram.
note: *And he went in to her, and she conceived and bare him a son, and he called his name Ishmael, in the fifth year of this week; and this was the eighty-sixth year in the life of Abram.* (Jubilees 14:24). The restored witness carries the birth verse-for-verse with *Hagar bare Abram a son: and Abram called his son's name... Ishmael* (Genesis 16:15) and *Abram was fourscore and six years old, when Hagar bare Ishmael* (Genesis 16:16) — the same son, the same name, the same eighty-sixth year of Abram's life.

quote: And Yahuah (God) appeared to Abram, and said to him: "I am El Shaddai (God Almighty); approve yourself before Me and be you perfect."
live_here: And Yahuah (God) appeared to Abram, and said to him: “I am El Shaddai (God Almighty); approve yourself before Me and be you perfect.
live_proposed: And Yahuah (God) appeared to Abram, and said to him: “I am El Shaddai (God Almighty); approve yourself before Me and be you perfect.
note: *And Yahuah (God) appeared to Abram, and said to him: "I am El Shaddai (God Almighty); approve yourself before Me and be you perfect."* (Jubilees 15:3). The restored witness carries the appearing and the charge verse-for-verse with Genesis 17:1 — *I am the El Shaddai (Almighty God); walk before me, and be thou perfect* — the same Name of the Almighty and the same call to a perfect walk before Him.

quote: Neither will your name any more be called Abram, But your name from henceforth, even for ever, shall be Abraham. For the father of many nations have I made you... And I shall make you into nations, And kings will come forth from you
live_here: Neither will your name any more be called Abram, But your name from henceforth, even for ever, shall be Abraham. For the father of many nations have I made you.
live_proposed: Neither will your name any more be called Abram, But your name from henceforth, even for ever, shall be Abraham. For the father of many nations have I made you.
note: *Neither will your name any more be called Abram, But your name from henceforth, even for ever, shall be Abraham. For the father of many nations have I made you... And I shall make you into nations, And kings will come forth from you* (Jubilees 15:7). The restored witness carries the name-change and the promise entire — *your name shall be Abraham; for a father of many nations have I made thee... and kings shall come out of thee* (Genesis 17:5-6) — the same renaming and the same word of nations and kings.

quote: (And I shall give to you and to your seed after you) the land where you have been a sojourner, the land of Canaan, that you may possess it for ever, and I shall be their Elohim (God)
live_here: (And I shall give to you and to your seed after you) the land where you have been a sojourner, the land of Canaan, that you may possess it for ever, and I shall be their Elohim (God)."
live_proposed: (And I shall give to you and to your seed after you) the land where you have been a sojourner, the land of Canaan, that you may possess it for ever, and I shall be their Elohim (God)."
note: *(And I shall give to you and to your seed after you) the land where you have been a sojourner, the land of Canaan, that you may possess it for ever, and I shall be their Elohim (God)* (Jubilees 15:10). The restored witness keeps the land-grant of Genesis 17:8 — *the land wherein thou art a stranger, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession; and I will be their Elohim* — the same land of the sojourning given as an everlasting possession to the seed.

quote: And as for you, do you keep My Covenant, you and your seed after you, and circumcise you every male among you, and circumcise your foreskins, and it will be a token of an eternal covenant between Me and you
live_here: And Yahuah (God) said to Abraham: "And as for you, do you keep My Covenant, you and your seed after you, and circumcise you every male among you, and circumcise your foreskins, and it will be a token of an eternal covenant between Me and you.
live_proposed: And Yahuah (God) said to Abraham: "And as for you, do you keep My Covenant, you and your seed after you, and circumcise you every male among you, and circumcise your foreskins, and it will be a token of an eternal covenant between Me and you.
note: *And as for you, do you keep My Covenant, you and your seed after you, and circumcise you every male among you, and circumcise your foreskins, and it will be a token of an eternal covenant between Me and you* (Jubilees 15:11). The restored witness names the sign exactly as Genesis 17:11 does — *it shall be a token of the covenant betwixt me and you* — and weights it *a token of an eternal covenant*: the circumcision of the flesh as the everlasting sign, kept by the seed throughout their generations.

quote: This law is for all the generations for ever, and there is no circumcision of the days, and no omission of one day out of the eight days; for it is an eternal ordinance, ordained and written on the heavenly tables
live_here: This law is for all the generations for ever, and there is no circumcision of the days, and no omission of one day out of the eight days; for it is an eternal ordinance, ordained and written on the heavenly tables.
live_proposed: This law is for all the generations for ever, and there is no circumcision of the days, and no omission of one day out of the eight days; for it is an eternal ordinance, ordained and written on the heavenly tables.
note: *This law is for all the generations for ever, and there is no circumcision of the days, and no omission of one day out of the eight days; for it is an eternal ordinance, ordained and written on the heavenly tables* (Jubilees 15:25). Against the warning of Genesis 17:14 — *the uncircumcised... that soul shall be cut off from his people; he hath broken my covenant* — the restored witness sets the sign as *an eternal ordinance, ordained and written on the heavenly tables*: never abolished, the everlasting covenant in the flesh.

quote: And Elohim (God) said to Abraham: "As for Sarai your wife, her name will no more be called Sarai, but Sarah will be her name."
live_here: And Elohim (God) said to Abraham: “As for Sarai your wife, her name will no more be called Sarai, but Sarah will be her name.
live_proposed: And Elohim (God) said to Abraham: “As for Sarai your wife, her name will no more be called Sarai, but Sarah will be her name.
note: *And Elohim (God) said to Abraham: "As for Sarai your wife, her name will no more be called Sarai, but Sarah will be her name."* (Jubilees 15:15). The restored witness carries the renaming of Genesis 17:15 word for word — *As for Sarai thy wife, thou shalt not call her name Sarai, but Sarah shall her name be* — the covenant name-change that sets her as the mother of the promised seed.

quote: And I shall bless her, and give you a son by her, and I shall bless him, and he will become a nation, and kings of nations will proceed from him
live_here: And I shall bless her, and give you a son by her, and I shall bless him, and he will become a nation, and kings of nations will proceed from him.”
live_proposed: And I shall bless her, and give you a son by her, and I shall bless him, and he will become a nation, and kings of nations will proceed from him.”
note: *And I shall bless her, and give you a son by her, and I shall bless him, and he will become a nation, and kings of nations will proceed from him* (Jubilees 15:16). The restored witness keeps the blessing on Sarah of Genesis 17:16 — *I will bless her, and give thee a son also of her... and she shall be a mother of nations; kings of people shall be of her* — the same blessing, the same son, and the kings of nations to come from the line.

quote: But My covenant shall I establish with Isaac, whom Sarah will bear to you, in these days, in the next year
live_here: But My covenant shall I establish with Isaac, whom Sarah will bear to you, in these days, in the next year.”
live_proposed: But My covenant shall I establish with Isaac, whom Sarah will bear to you, in these days, in the next year.”
note: *But My covenant shall I establish with Isaac, whom Sarah will bear to you, in these days, in the next year* (Jubilees 15:21). The restored witness carries the narrowing of Genesis 17:21 word for word — *my covenant will I establish with Isaac, which Sarah shall bear unto thee at this set time in the next year* — the covenant-seed established with the son of promise, at the appointed time.

quote: And as for Ishmael also have I heard you, and behold I shall bless him, and make him great, and multiply him exceedingly, and he will beget twelve princes, and I shall make him a great nation
live_here: And as for Ishmael also have I heard you, and behold I shall bless him, and make him great, and multiply him exceedingly, and he will beget twelve princes, and I shall make him a great nation.
live_proposed: And as for Ishmael also have I heard you, and behold I shall bless him, and make him great, and multiply him exceedingly, and he will beget twelve princes, and I shall make him a great nation.
note: *And as for Ishmael also have I heard you, and behold I shall bless him, and make him great, and multiply him exceedingly, and he will beget twelve princes, and I shall make him a great nation* (Jubilees 15:20). The restored witness keeps the blessing on Ishmael of Genesis 17:20 — *I have blessed him... twelve princes shall he beget, and I will make him a great nation* — Ishmael blessed in the flesh as a great nation, even as the covenant-seed is reserved for Isaac.

quote: And on the new moon of the fourth month we appeared to Abraham, at the oak of Mamre, and we talked with him, and we announced to him that a son would be given to him by Sarah his wife
live_here: And on the new moon of the fourth month we appeared to Abraham, at the oak of Mamre, and we talked with him, and we announced to him that a son would be given to him by Sarah his wife.
live_proposed: And on the new moon of the fourth month we appeared to Abraham, at the oak of Mamre, and we talked with him, and we announced to him that a son would be given to him by Sarah his wife.
note: *And on the new moon of the fourth month we appeared to Abraham, at the oak of Mamre, and we talked with him, and we announced to him that a son would be given to him by Sarah his wife* (Jubilees 16:1). The restored witness keeps the scene — the appearing *at the oak of Mamre* and the announcement of *a son... by Sarah his wife* — matching *Yahuah (LORD) appeared unto him in the plains of Mamre* (Genesis 18:1) and *Sarah thy wife shall have a son* (Genesis 18:10), and dates it to the new moon of the fourth month.

quote: And (that) when we returned to her at a set time, she would have conceived a son
live_here: And (that) when we returned to her at a set time, she would have conceived a son.
live_proposed: And (that) when we returned to her at a set time, she would have conceived a son.
note: *And (that) when we returned to her at a set time, she would have conceived a son* (Jubilees 16:4). The restored witness carries the set-time return — *when we returned to her at a set time, she would have conceived a son* — matching *I will certainly return unto thee according to the time of life; and, lo, Sarah thy wife shall have a son* (Genesis 18:10) and *At the time appointed I will return* (Genesis 18:14).

quote: And Sarah laughed, for she heard that we had spoken these words with Abraham, and we admonished her, and she became afraid, and denied that she had laughed on account of the words
live_here: And Sarah laughed, for she heard that we had spoken these words with Abraham, and we admonished her, and she became afraid, and denied that she had laughed on account of the words.
live_proposed: And Sarah laughed, for she heard that we had spoken these words with Abraham, and we admonished her, and she became afraid, and denied that she had laughed on account of the words.
note: *And Sarah laughed, for she heard that we had spoken these words with Abraham, and we admonished her, and she became afraid, and denied that she had laughed on account of the words* (Jubilees 16:2). The restored witness keeps the whole movement — Sarah hearing, laughing, being admonished, growing afraid, and denying — matching *Sarah laughed within herself* (Genesis 18:12) and *Then Sarah denied, saying, I laughed not; for she was afraid* (Genesis 18:15).

quote: And in this month Yahuah (God) executed his judgments on Sodom, and Gomorrah, and Zeboim, and all the region of the Jordan, and He burned them with fire and brimstone, and destroyed them until this day... that they are wicked and sinners exceedingly

live_proposed: And in this month Yahuah (God) executed his judgments on Sodom, and Gomorrah, and Zeboim, and all the region of the Jordan, and He burned them with fire and brimstone, and destroyed them until this day, even as lo I have declared to you all their works, that they are wicked and sinners exceedingly, and that they defile themselves and commit fornication in their flesh, and work uncleanness on the earth.
note: *And in this month Yahuah (God) executed his judgments on Sodom, and Gomorrah, and Zeboim, and all the region of the Jordan, and He burned them with fire and brimstone, and destroyed them until this day... that they are wicked and sinners exceedingly* (Jubilees 16:5). The restored witness names the cause and the sentence — the cities *wicked and sinners exceedingly*, judged with *fire and brimstone* — matching *the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great, and... their sin is very grievous* (Genesis 18:20). The Judge of all the earth saw the cry and did right.

quote: And, in like manner, Elohim (God) will execute judgment on the places where they have done according to the uncleanness of the Sodomites, like to the judgment of Sodom. But Lot we saved; for Elohim (God) remembered Abraham, and sent him out from the midst of the overthrow
live_here: But Lot we saved; for Elohim (God) remembered Abraham, and sent him out from the midst of the overthrow.
live_proposed: But Lot we saved; for Elohim (God) remembered Abraham, and sent him out from the midst of the overthrow.
note: *And, in like manner, Elohim (God) will execute judgment on the places where they have done according to the uncleanness of the Sodomites, like to the judgment of Sodom. But Lot we saved; for Elohim (God) remembered Abraham, and sent him out from the midst of the overthrow* (Jubilees 16:7). The intercession of *Wilt thou also destroy the righteous with the wicked?* (Genesis 18:23) bore fruit: *Lot we saved; for Elohim remembered Abraham*. The Judge who does right does not slay the righteous with the wicked — He remembers the intercessor and draws the one righteous man out of the fire.

quote: And in this month Yahuah (God) executed his judgments on Sodom, and Gomorrah, and Zeboim, and all the region of the Jordan, and He burned them with fire and brimstone, and destroyed them until this day

live_proposed: And in this month Yahuah (God) executed his judgments on Sodom, and Gomorrah, and Zeboim, and all the region of the Jordan, and He burned them with fire and brimstone, and destroyed them until this day, even as lo I have declared to you all their works, that they are wicked and sinners exceedingly, and that they defile themselves and commit fornication in their flesh, and work uncleanness on the earth.
note: *And in this month Yahuah (God) executed his judgments on Sodom, and Gomorrah, and Zeboim, and all the region of the Jordan, and He burned them with fire and brimstone, and destroyed them until this day* (Jubilees 16:5). The restored witness names the overthrow of *brimstone and fire from Yahuah (LORD) out of heaven* (Genesis 19:24) as Yahuah's executed judgment — *He burned them with fire and brimstone* — on Sodom, Gomorrah, and all the region of the Jordan, a destruction standing *until this day*.

quote: But Lot we saved; for Elohim (God) remembered Abraham, and sent him out from the midst of the overthrow
live_here: But Lot we saved; for Elohim (God) remembered Abraham, and sent him out from the midst of the overthrow.
live_proposed: But Lot we saved; for Elohim (God) remembered Abraham, and sent him out from the midst of the overthrow.
note: *But Lot we saved; for Elohim (God) remembered Abraham, and sent him out from the midst of the overthrow* (Jubilees 16:7). The restored witness carries the hinge verse-for-verse — *Elohim remembered Abraham, and sent him out from the midst of the overthrow* — matching *Elohim (God) remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out of the midst of the overthrow* (Genesis 19:29). The intercession of Abraham at the oak (Genesis 18) bears its fruit in the saving of Lot.

Worship them not: Worship the Elohim (God) of heaven, Who causes the rain and the dew to descend on the earth..."

note: Jubilees 12:2 — *And he said, "What help and profit have we from those idols which you do worship, And before which you do bow yourself? For there is no spirit in them, For they are dumb forms, and a misleading of the heart. Worship them not: Worship the Elohim (God) of heaven, Who causes the rain and the dew to descend on the earth..."* The same Abraham, in the same house of Terah's idols, declares the dumb forms have no spirit and calls his father to the living Elohim.

quote: And he said, "What help and profit have we from those idols which you do worship, And before which you do bow yourself? For there is no spirit in them, For they are dumb forms, and a misleading of the heart..."

For there is no spirit in them, For they are dumb forms, and a misleading of the heart..."* Jubilees gives the same young Abraham pleading with the same idol-keeping father over the same lifeless wares.

quote: Get you up from your country, and from your kindred and from the house of your father to a land which I shall show you, and I shall make you a great and numerous nation.
live_here: And he made an end of speaking and praying, and behold the word of Yahuah (God) was sent to him through me, saying: "Get you up from your country, and from your kindred and from the house of your father to a land which I shall show you, and I shall make you a great and numerous nation.
live_proposed: And he made an end of speaking and praying, and behold the word of Yahuah (God) was sent to him through me, saying: "Get you up from your country, and from your kindred and from the house of your father to a land which I shall show you, and I shall make you a great and numerous nation.
note: Jubilees 12:22 — *Get you up from your country, and from your kindred and from the house of your father to a land which I shall show you, and I shall make you a great and numerous nation.* The parallel restored record gives the identical call out of the father's house that meets Apocalypse of Abraham 8:4.

quote: All the signs of the stars, and the signs of the moon and of the sun are all in the hand of Yahuah (God)... You alone are my Elohim (God)... And You have created all things, And all things that are are the work of Your hands.
live_here: And a word came into his heart and he said: "All the signs of the stars, and the signs of the moon and of the sun are all in the hand of Yahuah (God). Why do I search (them) out?
live_proposed: And a word came into his heart and he said: "All the signs of the stars, and the signs of the moon and of the sun are all in the hand of Yahuah (God). Why do I search (them) out?
note: Jubilees 12:17 — *All the signs of the stars, and the signs of the moon and of the sun are all in the hand of Yahuah (God)... You alone are my Elohim (God)... And You have created all things, And all things that are are the work of Your hands.* The parallel restored record gives Abraham's own confession of the Creator that meets the "I am He" of Apocalypse of Abraham 8:3.

quote: And we did according to all His words: all the malignant evil ones we bound in the place of condemnation, and a tenth part of them we left that they might be subject before Satan on the earth.
live_here: And we did according to all His words: all the malignant evil ones we bound in the place of condemnation, and a tenth part of them we left that they might be subject before Satan on the earth.
live_proposed: And we did according to all His words: all the malignant evil ones we bound in the place of condemnation, and a tenth part of them we left that they might be subject before Satan on the earth.
note: Jubilees 10:11 — *And we did according to all His words: all the malignant evil ones we bound in the place of condemnation, and a tenth part of them we left that they might be subject before Satan on the earth.* The remnant of evil spirits left subject to Satan is the host of Sammael at war in Ascension of Isaiah 7:9.

quote: And the chief of the spirits, Mastêmâ, came and said: “Yahuah (God), Creator, let some of them remain before me, and let them hearken to my voice, and do all that I shall say to them; for if some of them are not left to me, I shall not be able to execute the power of my will on the sons of men; for these are for corruption and leading astray before my judgment, for great is the wickedness of the sons of men.” And He said: “Let the tenth part of them remain before him, and let nine parts descend into the place of condemnation.”
live_here: And the chief of the spirits, Mastêmâ, came and said: “Yahuah (God), Creator, let some of them remain before me, and let them hearken to my voice, and do all that I shall say to them; for if some of them are not left to me, I shall not be able to execute the power of my will on the sons of men; for these are for corruption and leading astray before my judgment, for great is the wickedness of the sons of men.”
live_proposed: And the chief of the spirits, Mastêmâ, came and said: “Yahuah (God), Creator, let some of them remain before me, and let them hearken to my voice, and do all that I shall say to them; for if some of them are not left to me, I shall not be able to execute the power of my will on the sons of men; for these are for corruption and leading astray before my judgment, for great is the wickedness of the sons of men.”
note: Jubilees 10:8 — *And the chief of the spirits, Mastêmâ, came and said: “Yahuah (God), Creator, let some of them remain before me, and let them hearken to my voice, and do all that I shall say to them; for if some of them are not left to me, I shall not be able to execute the power of my will on the sons of men; for these are for corruption and leading astray before my judgment, for great is the wickedness of the sons of men.” And He said: “Let the tenth part of them remain before him, and let nine parts descend into the place of condemnation.”* The chief-of-spirits left to rule is the same Sammael with his hosts envying in the firmament in Ascension of Isaiah 7:9.

quote: And in this month Abraham moved from Hebron, and departed and dwelt between Kadesh and Shur in the mountains of Gerar
live_here: And in this month Abraham moved from Hebron, and departed and dwelt between Kadesh and Shur in the mountains of Gerar.
live_proposed: And in this month Abraham moved from Hebron, and departed and dwelt between Kadesh and Shur in the mountains of Gerar.
note: *And in this month Abraham moved from Hebron, and departed and dwelt between Kadesh and Shur in the mountains of Gerar* (Jubilees 16:10). The restored witness records the very relocation that opens this chapter — *Abraham... dwelled between Kadesh and Shur, and sojourned in Gerar* (Genesis 20:1) — set in the same season the judgment of Sodom is sealed and Isaac's birth announced, the seed of promise on the very threshold of coming.

quote: And in the middle of the sixth month Yahuah (God) visited Sarah and did to her as He had spoken, and she conceived. And she bare a son in the third month... at the time of which Yahuah (God) had spoken to Abraham, on the festival of the first-fruits of the harvest, Isaac was born
live_here: And in the middle of the sixth month Yahuah (God) visited Sarah and did to her as He had spoken, and she conceived.
live_proposed: And in the middle of the sixth month Yahuah (God) visited Sarah and did to her as He had spoken, and she conceived.
note: *And in the middle of the sixth month Yahuah (God) visited Sarah and did to her as He had spoken, and she conceived. And she bare a son in the third month... at the time of which Yahuah (God) had spoken to Abraham, on the festival of the first-fruits of the harvest, Isaac was born* (Jubilees 16:12). The restored witness carries *Yahuah visited Sarah as he had said* (Genesis 21:1) and the *set time* (Genesis 21:2) verse-for-verse — and binds the birth to an appointed time, the festival of the first-fruits of the harvest.

quote: in Isaac shall your name and seed be called
live_here: And Elohim (God) said to Abraham “Let it not be grievous in your sight, because of the child and because of the bondwoman; in all that Sarah has said to you, hearken to her words and do (them); for in Isaac shall your name and seed be called.
live_proposed: And Elohim (God) said to Abraham “Let it not be grievous in your sight, because of the child and because of the bondwoman; in all that Sarah has said to you, hearken to her words and do (them); for in Isaac shall your name and seed be called.
note: *And Elohim (God) said to Abraham "Let it not be grievous in your sight, because of the child and because of the bondwoman; in all that Sarah has said to you, hearken to her words and do them; for in Isaac shall your name and seed be called* (Jubilees 17:6). The restored witness carries the word entire — *in Isaac shall your name and seed be called* — matching *in Isaac shall thy seed be called* (Genesis 21:12), the elect line named through the son of promise.

quote: ...but (that) in Isaac should his name and seed be called
live_here: And we returned in the seventh month, and found Sarah with child before us and we blessed him, and we announced to him all the things which had been decreed concerning him, that he should not die till he should beget six sons more, and should see (them) before he died; but (that) in Isaac should his name and seed be called:
live_proposed: And we returned in the seventh month, and found Sarah with child before us and we blessed him, and we announced to him all the things which had been decreed concerning him, that he should not die till he should beget six sons more, and should see (them) before he died; but (that) in Isaac should his name and seed be called:
note: *...but (that) in Isaac should his name and seed be called* (Jubilees 16:16). Before the casting-out, the heavenly word was announced to Abraham: *in Isaac should his name and seed be called* — the same election as *in Isaac shall thy seed be called* (Genesis 21:12). The seed-line through Isaac is decreed, not the choosing of a moment's grief.

quote: And Sarah saw Ishmael playing and dancing and Abraham rejoicing with great joy, and she became jealous of Ishmael and said to Abraham, "Cast out this bondwoman and her son; for the son of this bondwoman will not be heir with my son, Isaac."
live_here: And Sarah saw Ishmael playing and dancing and Abraham rejoicing with great joy, and she became jealous of Ishmael and said to Abraham, “Cast out this bondwoman and her son; for the son of this bondwoman will not be heir with my son, Isaac.”
live_proposed: And Sarah saw Ishmael playing and dancing and Abraham rejoicing with great joy, and she became jealous of Ishmael and said to Abraham, “Cast out this bondwoman and her son; for the son of this bondwoman will not be heir with my son, Isaac.”
note: *And Sarah saw Ishmael playing and dancing and Abraham rejoicing with great joy, and she became jealous of Ishmael and said to Abraham, "Cast out this bondwoman and her son; for the son of this bondwoman will not be heir with my son, Isaac."* (Jubilees 17:4). The restored witness keeps Sarah's word verse-for-verse — *Cast out this bondwoman and her son; for the son of this bondwoman will not be heir with my son, Isaac* — matching *Cast out this bondwoman and her son... even with Isaac* (Genesis 21:10).

quote: And an angel of Elohim (God), one of the holy ones, said to her, "Why weep you, Hagar? Arise, take the child, and hold him in your hand; for Elohim (God) has heard your voice, and has seen the child."
live_here: And an angel of Elohim (God), one of the holy ones, said to her, “Why weep you, Hagar? Arise, take the child, and hold him in your hand; for Elohim (God) has heard your voice, and has seen the child.”
live_proposed: And an angel of Elohim (God), one of the holy ones, said to her, “Why weep you, Hagar? Arise, take the child, and hold him in your hand; for Elohim (God) has heard your voice, and has seen the child.”
note: *And an angel of Elohim (God), one of the holy ones, said to her, "Why weep you, Hagar? Arise, take the child, and hold him in your hand; for Elohim (God) has heard your voice, and has seen the child."* (Jubilees 17:11). The restored witness carries the angel's word — *Elohim has heard your voice, and has seen the child* — matching *Elohim (God) heard the voice of the lad... Elohim (God) hath heard the voice of the lad where he is* (Genesis 21:17), the bondwoman's son heard in the wilderness.

quote: And he built there an altar to Yahuah (God) who had delivered him... at the Well of the Oath, and he was the first to celebrate the feast of tabernacles on the earth
live_here: And he built there an altar to Yahuah (God) who had delivered him, and who was making him rejoice in the land of his sojourning, and he celebrated a festival of joy in this month seven days, near the altar which he had built at the Well of the Oath.
live_proposed: And he built there an altar to Yahuah (God) who had delivered him, and who was making him rejoice in the land of his sojourning, and he celebrated a festival of joy in this month seven days, near the altar which he had built at the Well of the Oath.
note: *And he built there an altar to Yahuah (God) who had delivered him... at the Well of the Oath, and he was the first to celebrate the feast of tabernacles on the earth* (Jubilees 16:20-21). The restored witness sets the worship at the oath-well — *he built there an altar to Yahuah... at the Well of the Oath* — beside *called there on the name of Yahuah (LORD), El Olam (the everlasting God)* (Genesis 21:33), and binds the grove-and-altar to the first feast of tabernacles, the appointed-times root of the calling on the Name.

quote: And Elohim (God) said to him, "Abraham, Abraham"; and he said, "Behold, (here) am I." And He said, "Take your beloved son whom you love, (even) Isaac, and go to the high country, and offer him on one of the mountains which I will point out to you."
live_here: And He said, “Take your beloved son whom you love, (even) Isaac, and go to the high country, and offer him on one of the mountains which I will point out to you.”
live_proposed: And He said, “Take your beloved son whom you love, (even) Isaac, and go to the high country, and offer him on one of the mountains which I will point out to you.”
note: *And Elohim (God) said to him, "Abraham, Abraham"; and he said, "Behold, (here) am I." And He said, "Take your beloved son whom you love, (even) Isaac, and go to the high country, and offer him on one of the mountains which I will point out to you."* (Jubilees 18:2). The restored witness keeps the call verse-for-verse with *Take now thy son, thine only son Isaac, whom thou lovest... offer him there for a burnt offering upon one of the mountains* (Genesis 22:2) — *your beloved son whom you love*, the only son named for the offering.

quote: And he came to a well of water, and he said to his young men, "Abide you here with the ass, and I and the lad shall go (yonder), and when we have worshipped we shall come again to you."
live_here: And he came to a well of water, and he said to his young men, “Abide you here with the ass, and I and the lad shall go (yonder), and when we have worshipped we shall come again to you.”
live_proposed: And he came to a well of water, and he said to his young men, “Abide you here with the ass, and I and the lad shall go (yonder), and when we have worshipped we shall come again to you.”
note: *And he came to a well of water, and he said to his young men, "Abide you here with the ass, and I and the lad shall go (yonder), and when we have worshipped we shall come again to you."* (Jubilees 18:4). The restored witness keeps the word of return entire — *when we have worshipped we shall come again to you* — the same resurrection-faith of *I and the lad will go yonder and worship, and come again to you* (Genesis 22:5): both will return.

quote: And he said, "Elohim (God) will provide for himself a sheep for a burnt-offering, my son." And he drew near to the place of the mount of Elohim (God)
live_here: And he said, “Elohim (God) will provide for himself a sheep for a burnt-offering, my son.” And he drew near to the place of the mount of Elohim (God).
live_proposed: And he said, “Elohim (God) will provide for himself a sheep for a burnt-offering, my son.” And he drew near to the place of the mount of Elohim (God).
note: *And he said, "Elohim (God) will provide for himself a sheep for a burnt-offering, my son." And he drew near to the place of the mount of Elohim (God)* (Jubilees 18:7). The restored witness keeps the great answer — *Elohim will provide for himself a sheep for a burnt-offering* — matching *My son, Elohim (God) will provide himself a lamb for a burnt offering* (Genesis 22:8). The provision is Yahuah's own to make; Abraham walks on in the faith that the offering will be given by the One who commanded it.

quote: And Isaac said to his father, "Father"; and he said, "Here am I, my son." And he said to him, "Behold the fire, and the knife, and the wood; but where is the sheep for the burnt-offering, father?"
live_here: And Isaac said to his father, “Father”; and he said, “Here am I, my son.” And he said to him, “Behold the fire, and the knife, and the wood; but where is the sheep for the burnt-offering, father?”
live_proposed: And Isaac said to his father, “Father”; and he said, “Here am I, my son.” And he said to him, “Behold the fire, and the knife, and the wood; but where is the sheep for the burnt-offering, father?”
note: *And Isaac said to his father, "Father"; and he said, "Here am I, my son." And he said to him, "Behold the fire, and the knife, and the wood; but where is the sheep for the burnt-offering, father?"* (Jubilees 18:6). The restored witness carries the son's question whole — *where is the sheep for the burnt-offering, father?* — the same ache of *Behold the fire and the wood: but where is the lamb for a burnt offering?* (Genesis 22:7), the son bearing the wood and asking after the very offering he is to become.

quote: And I said to him: "Lay not your hand upon the lad, neither do you anything to him; for now I have shown that you fear Yahuah (God), and have not withheld your son, your first-born son, from me."
live_here: And I said to him: “Lay not your hand upon the lad, neither do you anything to him; for now I have shown that you fear Yahuah (God), and have not withheld your son, your first-born son, from me.”
live_proposed: And I said to him: “Lay not your hand upon the lad, neither do you anything to him; for now I have shown that you fear Yahuah (God), and have not withheld your son, your first-born son, from me.”
note: *And I said to him: "Lay not your hand upon the lad, neither do you anything to him; for now I have shown that you fear Yahuah (God), and have not withheld your son, your first-born son, from me."* (Jubilees 18:11). The restored witness keeps the staying word — *Lay not your hand upon the lad... you fear Yahuah... and have not withheld your son* — verse-for-verse with *Lay not thine hand upon the lad... for now I know that thou fearest Elohim (God), seeing thou hast not withheld thy son, thine only son from me* (Genesis 22:12).

quote: a single ram caught by his horns... offered it for a burnt-offering in the stead of his son
live_here: And the prince of the Mastêmâ was put to shame; and Abraham lifted up his eyes and looked, and, behold, a single ram caught … by his horns, and Abraham went and took the ram and offered it for a burnt-offering in the stead of his son.
live_proposed: And the prince of the Mastêmâ was put to shame; and Abraham lifted up his eyes and looked, and, behold, a single ram caught … by his horns, and Abraham went and took the ram and offered it for a burnt-offering in the stead of his son.
note: *And Abraham lifted up his eyes and looked, and, behold, a single ram caught by his horns, and Abraham went and took the ram and offered it for a burnt-offering in the stead of his son* (Jubilees 18:12). The restored witness carries the substitution entire — *a single ram caught by his horns... offered it for a burnt-offering in the stead of his son* — matching *a ram caught in a thicket by his horns: and Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering in the stead of his son* (Genesis 22:13). The ram dies that the son may live.

quote: And Abraham called that place "Yahuah (God) has seen," so that it is said "(in the mount) Yahuah (God) has seen": that is Mount Sion
live_here: And Abraham called that place “Yahuah (God) has seen,” so that it is said “(in the mount) Yahuah (God) has seen”: that is Mount Sion.
live_proposed: And Abraham called that place “Yahuah (God) has seen,” so that it is said “(in the mount) Yahuah (God) has seen”: that is Mount Sion.
note: *And Abraham called that place "Yahuah (God) has seen," so that it is said "(in the mount) Yahuah (God) has seen": that is Mount Sion* (Jubilees 18:13). The restored witness names the mount outright — *that is Mount Sion* — binding *Abraham called the name of that place Yahuah Yireh (Jehovah-jireh)... In the mount of Yahuah (LORD) it shall be seen* (Genesis 22:14) to the holy hill of Yahuah's house: the mount of provision and the mount of His dwelling are one.

quote: And in your seed will all nations of the earth be blessed; Because you have obeyed My voice, And I have shown to all that you are faithful to Me in all that I have said to you
live_here: And in your seed will all nations of the earth be blessed; Because you have obeyed My voice, And I have shown to all that you are faithful to Me in all that I have said to you: Go in peace."
live_proposed: And in your seed will all nations of the earth be blessed; Because you have obeyed My voice, And I have shown to all that you are faithful to Me in all that I have said to you: Go in peace."
note: *And in your seed will all nations of the earth be blessed; Because you have obeyed My voice, And I have shown to all that you are faithful to Me in all that I have said to you* (Jubilees 18:16). The restored witness keeps the seal — *Because you have obeyed My voice... you are faithful to Me in all that I have said to you* — matching *because thou hast obeyed my voice* (Genesis 22:18). The blessing of the nations in the seed rests on the obedience proven faithful; the faith counted righteous is the faith that did what it was told.

quote: And He said: "By Myself have I sworn, says Yahuah (God), Because you have done this thing, And have not withheld your son, your beloved son, from Me, That in blessing I shall bless you And in multiplying I shall multiply your seed As the stars of heaven, And as the sand which is on the seashore."
live_here: And He said: "By Myself have I sworn, says Yahuah (God), Because you have done this thing, And have not withheld your son, your beloved son, from Me, That in blessing I shall bless you And in multiplying I shall multiply your seed As the stars of heaven, And as the sand which is on the seashore. And your seed will inherit the cities of its enemies,
live_proposed: And He said: "By Myself have I sworn, says Yahuah (God), Because you have done this thing, And have not withheld your son, your beloved son, from Me, That in blessing I shall bless you And in multiplying I shall multiply your seed As the stars of heaven, And as the sand which is on the seashore. And your seed will inherit the cities of its enemies,
note: *And He said: "By Myself have I sworn, says Yahuah (God), Because you have done this thing, And have not withheld your son, your beloved son, from Me, That in blessing I shall bless you And in multiplying I shall multiply your seed As the stars of heaven, And as the sand which is on the seashore."* (Jubilees 18:15). The restored witness keeps the oath entire — *By Myself have I sworn... in blessing I shall bless you And in multiplying I shall multiply your seed As the stars of heaven, And as the sand which is on the seashore* — matching the sworn blessing of Genesis 22:16-17, the seed beyond number bound by Yahuah's own self.

quote: And he said not a single word regarding the rumour in the land how that Elohim (God) had said that He would give it to him and to his seed after him, and he begged a place there to bury his dead; for he was found faithful, and was recorded on the heavenly tables as the friend of Elohim (God)
live_here: And he said not a single word regarding the rumour in the land how that Elohim (God) had said that He would give it to him and to his seed after him, and he begged a place there to bury his dead; for he was found faithful, and was recorded on the heavenly tables as the friend of Elohim (God).
live_proposed: And he said not a single word regarding the rumour in the land how that Elohim (God) had said that He would give it to him and to his seed after him, and he begged a place there to bury his dead; for he was found faithful, and was recorded on the heavenly tables as the friend of Elohim (God).
note: *And he said not a single word regarding the rumour in the land how that Elohim (God) had said that He would give it to him and to his seed after him, and he begged a place there to bury his dead; for he was found faithful, and was recorded on the heavenly tables as the friend of Elohim (God)* (Jubilees 19:9). The restored witness makes the trial plain: the whole land was promised to Abraham and his seed, yet he *begged a place there to bury his dead* and *said not a single word* of complaint. This is the faith behind *I am a stranger and a sojourner with you* (Genesis 23:4) — the heir who owns nothing but a grave, and is named *the friend of Elohim*.

quote: And Yahuah (God) gave him grace before all who saw him, and he besought in gentleness the sons of Heth, and they gave him the land of the double cave over against Mamre, that is Hebron, for four hundred pieces of silver
live_here: And Yahuah (God) gave him grace before all who saw him, and he besought in gentleness the sons of Heth, and they gave him the land of the double cave over against Mamre, that is Hebron, for four hundred pieces of silver.
live_proposed: And Yahuah (God) gave him grace before all who saw him, and he besought in gentleness the sons of Heth, and they gave him the land of the double cave over against Mamre, that is Hebron, for four hundred pieces of silver.
note: *And Yahuah (God) gave him grace before all who saw him, and he besought in gentleness the sons of Heth, and they gave him the land of the double cave over against Mamre, that is Hebron, for four hundred pieces of silver* (Jubilees 19:5). The restored witness keeps the purchase whole: Abraham besought the sons of Heth for *the cave of Machpelah, which he hath, which is in the end of his field... for a possession of a buryingplace* (Genesis 23:9), and received *the land of the double cave over against Mamre... for four hundred pieces of silver* — Machpelah meaning the double cave, the very price of Genesis 23:15-16.

quote: And they besought him, saying, "We shall give it to you for nothing"; but he would not take it from their hands for nothing, for he gave the price of the place, the money in full, and he bowed down before them twice; and after this he buried his dead in the double cave
live_here: And they besought him, saying, “We shall give it to you for nothing”; but he would not take it from their hands for nothing, for he gave the price of the place, the money in full, and he bowed down before them twice; and after this he buried his dead in the double cave.
live_proposed: And they besought him, saying, “We shall give it to you for nothing”; but he would not take it from their hands for nothing, for he gave the price of the place, the money in full, and he bowed down before them twice; and after this he buried his dead in the double cave.
note: *And they besought him, saying, "We shall give it to you for nothing"; but he would not take it from their hands for nothing, for he gave the price of the place, the money in full, and he bowed down before them twice; and after this he buried his dead in the double cave* (Jubilees 19:6). Ephron had said *the field give I thee, and the cave that is therein, I give it thee... bury thy dead* (Genesis 23:11), but Abraham *would not take it... for nothing* — *he gave the price of the place, the money in full*. The grave is bought outright, a true deed, not a gift to be reclaimed.

quote: And in the first year of the third week of this jubilee the days of the life of Sarah were accomplished, and she died in Hebron
live_here: And in the first year of the third week of this jubilee the days of the life of Sarah were accomplished, and she died in Hebron.
live_proposed: And in the first year of the third week of this jubilee the days of the life of Sarah were accomplished, and she died in Hebron.
note: *And in the first year of the third week of this jubilee the days of the life of Sarah were accomplished, and she died in Hebron* (Jubilees 19:2). The restored witness keeps the death of Sarah at Hebron — *Sarah died in Kirjath-arba; the same is Hebron in the land of Canaan* (Genesis 23:2) — *the days of the life of Sarah were accomplished, and she died in Hebron*. The mother of the promised seed dies in the land sworn to that seed.

quote: And Abraham went to mourn over her and bury her, and we tried him to see if his spirit were patient and he were not indignant in the words of his mouth; and he was found patient in this, and was not disturbed
live_here: And Abraham went to mourn over her and bury her, and we tried him to see if his spirit were patient and he were not indignant in the words of his mouth; and he was found patient in this, and was not disturbed.
live_proposed: And Abraham went to mourn over her and bury her, and we tried him to see if his spirit were patient and he were not indignant in the words of his mouth; and he was found patient in this, and was not disturbed.
note: *And Abraham went to mourn over her and bury her, and we tried him to see if his spirit were patient and he were not indignant in the words of his mouth; and he was found patient in this, and was not disturbed* (Jubilees 19:3). The mourning of Genesis 23:2 — *Abraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her* — is read in the restored witness as a trial of faith: *Abraham went to mourn over her and bury her... and he was found patient in this, and was not disturbed*. He grieves and trusts in the same breath.

quote: Let your hands be strong And let your heart rejoice in your son Jacob; For I have loved him far beyond all my sons. He will be blessed for ever, And his seed will fill the whole earth. If a man can number the sand of the earth, His seed also will be numbered
live_here: Let your hands be strong And let your heart rejoice in your son Jacob; For I have loved him far beyond all my sons. He will be blessed for ever, And his seed will fill the whole earth.
live_proposed: Let your hands be strong And let your heart rejoice in your son Jacob; For I have loved him far beyond all my sons. He will be blessed for ever, And his seed will fill the whole earth.
note: *Let your hands be strong And let your heart rejoice in your son Jacob; For I have loved him far beyond all my sons. He will be blessed for ever, And his seed will fill the whole earth. If a man can number the sand of the earth, His seed also will be numbered* (Jubilees 19:21). The restored witness carries the same innumerable-seed blessing on the next carrier of the line — *his seed will fill the whole earth... If a man can number the sand of the earth, His seed also will be numbered* — the very promise laid on the bride in *be thou the mother of thousands of millions, and let thy seed possess the gate of those which hate them* (Genesis 24:60), the seed beyond counting passed on through Rebekah's womb.

quote: And he placed two fingers of Jacob on his eyes, and he blessed the Elohim (God) of gods, and he covered his face and stretched out his feet and slept the sleep of eternity, and was gathered to his fathers
live_here: And he placed two fingers of Jacob on his eyes, and he blessed the Elohim (God) of gods, and he covered his face and stretched out his feet and slept the sleep of eternity, and was gathered to his fathers.
live_proposed: And he placed two fingers of Jacob on his eyes, and he blessed the Elohim (God) of gods, and he covered his face and stretched out his feet and slept the sleep of eternity, and was gathered to his fathers.
note: *And he placed two fingers of Jacob on his eyes, and he blessed the Elohim (God) of gods, and he covered his face and stretched out his feet and slept the sleep of eternity, and was gathered to his fathers* (Jubilees 23:1). The restored witness keeps the same idiom as *Abraham gave up the ghost, and died... and was gathered to his people* (Genesis 25:8): he *slept the sleep of eternity, and was gathered to his fathers*. Death is not annihilation but a gathering-to-the-fathers — the patriarchal hope, the man laid up with his people to await the promise.

quote: And Yahuah (God) appeared to him and said to him: "Go not down into Egypt; dwell in the land that I shall tell you of, and sojourn in this land, and I shall be with you and bless you."
live_here: And Yahuah (God) appeared to him and said to him: “Go not down into Egypt; dwell in the land that I shall tell you of, and sojourn in this land, and I shall be with you and bless you.
live_proposed: And Yahuah (God) appeared to him and said to him: “Go not down into Egypt; dwell in the land that I shall tell you of, and sojourn in this land, and I shall be with you and bless you.
note: *And Yahuah (God) appeared to him and said to him: "Go not down into Egypt; dwell in the land that I shall tell you of, and sojourn in this land, and I shall be with you and bless you."* (Jubilees 24:9). The restored witness keeps the word entire — *Go not down into Egypt; dwell in the land that I shall tell you of* — matching *Go not down into Egypt; dwell in the land which I shall tell thee of* (Genesis 26:2). Where Abraham went down to Egypt in the first famine, Isaac is forbidden it; the son must stay in the land of the oath.

quote: For to you and to your seed shall I give all this land, and I shall establish My oath which I sware to Abraham your father, and I shall multiply your seed as the stars of heaven, and shall give to your seed all this land
live_here: For to you and to your seed shall I give all this land, and I shall establish My oath which I sware to Abraham your father, and I shall multiply your seed as the stars of heaven, and shall give to your seed all this land.
live_proposed: For to you and to your seed shall I give all this land, and I shall establish My oath which I sware to Abraham your father, and I shall multiply your seed as the stars of heaven, and shall give to your seed all this land.
note: *For to you and to your seed shall I give all this land, and I shall establish My oath which I sware to Abraham your father, and I shall multiply your seed as the stars of heaven, and shall give to your seed all this land* (Jubilees 24:10). The restored witness carries the confirmation whole — *I shall establish My oath which I sware to Abraham your father, and I shall multiply your seed as the stars of heaven* — matching *I will perform the oath which I sware unto Abraham thy father; and I will make thy seed to multiply as the stars of heaven* (Genesis 26:3-4). The oath to the father is established to the son, the star-seed renewed.

quote: And in your seed will all the nations of the earth be blessed, because your father obeyed My voice, and kept My charge and My commandments, and My laws, and My ordinances, and My covenant; and now obey My voice and dwell in this land
live_here: And in your seed will all the nations of the earth be blessed, because your father obeyed My voice, and kept My charge and My commandments, and My laws, and My ordinances, and My covenant; and now obey My voice and dwell in this land.”
live_proposed: And in your seed will all the nations of the earth be blessed, because your father obeyed My voice, and kept My charge and My commandments, and My laws, and My ordinances, and My covenant; and now obey My voice and dwell in this land.”
note: *And in your seed will all the nations of the earth be blessed, because your father obeyed My voice, and kept My charge and My commandments, and My laws, and My ordinances, and My covenant; and now obey My voice and dwell in this land* (Jubilees 24:11). The restored witness keeps the keystone fuller still — *your father obeyed My voice, and kept My charge and My commandments, and My laws, and My ordinances, and My covenant* — matching *Abraham obeyed my voice, and kept my charge, my commandments, my statutes, and my laws* (Genesis 26:5), and adds the charge to the son: *now obey My voice*. The covenant blessing rests on the obedience proven, and the son is called to the same keeping.

quote: And they digged again the wells of water which the servants of Abraham, his father, had digged, and which the Philistines had closed after the death of Abraham his father, and he called their names as Abraham his father had named them
live_here: And they digged again the wells of water which the servants of Abraham, his father, had digged, and which the Philistines had closed after the death of Abraham his father, and he called their names as Abraham his father had named them.
live_proposed: And they digged again the wells of water which the servants of Abraham, his father, had digged, and which the Philistines had closed after the death of Abraham his father, and he called their names as Abraham his father had named them.
note: *And they digged again the wells of water which the servants of Abraham, his father, had digged, and which the Philistines had closed after the death of Abraham his father, and he called their names as Abraham his father had named them* (Jubilees 24:18). The restored witness keeps it verse-for-verse — *they digged again the wells... which the Philistines had closed after the death of Abraham... he called their names as Abraham his father had named them* — matching Genesis 26:18. The son restores both the wells and the names; nothing of the fathers' way is lost, only re-opened where it was stopped.

quote: And they dug a second well, and they strove for that also, and he called its name "Enmity." And he arose from thence and they digged another well, and for that they strove not, and he called the name of it "Room," and Isaac said: "Now Yahuah (God) has made room for us, and we have increased in the land."
live_here: And they dug a second well, and they strove for that also, and he called its name “Enmity.” And he arose from thence and they digged another well, and for that they strove not, and he called the name of it “Room,” and Isaac said: “Now Yahuah (God) has made room for us, and we have increased in the land.”
live_proposed: And they dug a second well, and they strove for that also, and he called its name “Enmity.” And he arose from thence and they digged another well, and for that they strove not, and he called the name of it “Room,” and Isaac said: “Now Yahuah (God) has made room for us, and we have increased in the land.”
note: *And they dug a second well, and they strove for that also, and he called its name "Enmity." And he arose from thence and they digged another well, and for that they strove not, and he called the name of it "Room," and Isaac said: "Now Yahuah (God) has made room for us, and we have increased in the land."* (Jubilees 24:20). The restored witness carries the three wells whole — Perversity, Enmity, and at last *Room*, *Now Yahuah (God) has made room for us* — matching Esek, Sitnah, and *Rehoboth... For now Yahuah (LORD) hath made room for us, and we shall be fruitful in the land* (Genesis 26:22). Through strife the son holds to the fathers' digging until Yahuah makes room.

quote: And Yahuah (God) appeared to him that night, on the new moon of the first month, and said to him: "I am the Elohim (God) of Abraham your father; fear not, for I am with you, and shall bless you and shall surely multiply your seed as the sand of the earth, for the sake of Abraham my servant."

The restored witness keeps the theophany entire — *I am the Elohim of Abraham your father; fear not, for I am with you... for the sake of Abraham my servant* — matching *I am the Elohim (God) of Abraham thy father: fear not, for I am with thee, and will bless thee, and multiply thy seed for my servant Abraham's sake* (Genesis 26:24). The One who appeared to the father appears to the son and names Himself by the father's covenant.

quote: And he built an altar there, which Abraham his father had first built, and he called upon the name of Yahuah (God), and he offered sacrifice to the Elohim (God) of Abraham his father
live_here: And he built an altar there, which Abraham his father had first built, and he called upon the name of Yahuah (God), and he offered sacrifice to the Elohim (God) of Abraham his father.
live_proposed: And he built an altar there, which Abraham his father had first built, and he called upon the name of Yahuah (God), and he offered sacrifice to the Elohim (God) of Abraham his father.
note: *And he built an altar there, which Abraham his father had first built, and he called upon the name of Yahuah (God), and he offered sacrifice to the Elohim (God) of Abraham his father* (Jubilees 24:23). The restored witness deepens *he builded an altar there, and called upon the name of Yahuah (LORD)* (Genesis 26:25): the altar was the one *Abraham his father had first built*. The son worships at the father's altar, calls on the same Name, offers to the same Elohim — the covenant-worship handed down unbroken from father to son.

quote: "The voice is Jacob's voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau," and he discerned him not, because it was a dispensation from heaven to remove his power of perception and Isaac discerned not, for his hands were hairy as (his brother) Esau's, so that he blessed him

The restored witness keeps the line whole — *The voice is Jacob's voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau* (Genesis 27:22) — and names the cause outright: *it was a dispensation from heaven to remove his power of perception*. Heaven, not Rebekah's cunning, settled where the blessing fell.

quote: "Behold, the smell of my son is as the smell of a (full) field which Yahuah (God) has blessed. And may Yahuah (God) give you of the dew of heaven And of the dew of the earth, and plenty of corn and oil: Let nations serve you, And peoples bow down to you."

And may Yahuah (God) give you of the dew of heaven And of the dew of the earth, and plenty of corn and oil: Let nations serve you, And peoples bow down to you."* (Jubilees 26:23). The restored witness keeps the blessing — *the dew of heaven And of the dew of the earth, and plenty of corn and oil* — matching *Therefore Elohim (God) give thee of the dew of heaven, and the fatness of the earth, and plenty of corn and wine* (Genesis 27:28). The bounty of heaven and earth is poured on the chosen seed.

quote: "Be lord over your brethren, And let your mother's sons bow down to you; And may all the blessings wherewith Yahuah (God) has blessed me and blessed Abraham, my father, Be imparted to you and to your seed for ever Cursed be he that curses you, And blessed be he that blesses you."

The restored witness makes the inheritance explicit: the bless/curse formula of *cursed be every one that curseth thee, and blessed be he that blesseth thee* (Genesis 27:29) is named as *all the blessings wherewith Yahuah has blessed me and blessed Abraham, my father... to you and to your seed for ever*. The Abrahamic seed-blessing is consciously handed down — Abraham to Isaac to Jacob to the seed for ever.

quote: Have you but one blessing, O father?... And Esau lifted up his voice and wept

live_proposed: And Esau said to Isaac, his father: “Have you but one blessing, O father? Bless me, (even) me also, father”: And Esau lifted up his voice and wept.
note: *And Esau said to Isaac, his father: "Have you but one blessing, O father? Bless me, (even) me also, father": And Esau lifted up his voice and wept* (Jubilees 26:32). The restored witness keeps the cry and the tears whole — *Have you but one blessing, O father?... And Esau lifted up his voice and wept* — matching *Hast thou but one blessing, my father?... And Esau lifted up his voice, and wept* (Genesis 27:38). The bitter cry of the brother who despised the birthright is recorded in every witness.

quote: "And by your sword will you live, And you will serve your brother. And it shall come to pass when you become great, And do shake his yoke from off your neck, You will sin a complete sin to death, And your seed will be rooted out from under heaven."

And it shall come to pass when you become great, And do shake his yoke from off your neck, You will sin a complete sin to death, And your seed will be rooted out from under heaven."* (Jubilees 26:34). The restored witness keeps Esau's blessing — *by your sword will you live, And you will serve your brother... do shake his yoke from off your neck* — matching *by thy sword shalt thou live, and shalt serve thy brother; and... thou shalt break his yoke from off thy neck* (Genesis 27:40), and sharpens the warning: *You will sin a complete sin to death, And your seed will be rooted out from under heaven*. The doom rests on the rebellion, the system set against the covenant.

quote: And Esau kept threatening Jacob because of the blessing wherewith his father blessed him, and he said in his heart: "May the days of mourning for my father now come, so that I may slay my brother Jacob."

live_proposed: And Esau kept threatening Jacob because of the blessing wherewith his father blessed him, and he said in his heart: “May the days of mourning for my father now come, so that I may slay my brother Jacob.”
note: *And Esau kept threatening Jacob because of the blessing wherewith his father blessed him, and he said in his heart: "May the days of mourning for my father now come, so that I may slay my brother Jacob."* (Jubilees 26:35). The restored witness keeps the murderous grudge whole — *Esau kept threatening Jacob... "May the days of mourning for my father now come, so that I may slay my brother Jacob"* — matching *Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing... The days of mourning for my father are at hand; then will I slay my brother Jacob* (Genesis 27:41). The hatred over the blessing becomes a settled plot of fratricide.

quote: And Rebecca went in and said to Isaac: "I loathe my life because of the two daughters of Heth, whom Esau has taken him as wives; and if Jacob take a wife from among the daughters of the land such as these, for what purpose do I further live; for the daughters of Canaan are evil."
live_here: And Rebecca went in and said to Isaac: “I loathe my life because of the two daughters of Heth, whom Esau has taken him as wives; and if Jacob take a wife from among the daughters of the land such as these, for what purpose do I further live; for the daughters of Canaan are evil.”
live_proposed: And Rebecca went in and said to Isaac: “I loathe my life because of the two daughters of Heth, whom Esau has taken him as wives; and if Jacob take a wife from among the daughters of the land such as these, for what purpose do I further live; for the daughters of Canaan are evil.”
note: *And Rebecca went in and said to Isaac: "I loathe my life because of the two daughters of Heth, whom Esau has taken him as wives; and if Jacob take a wife from among the daughters of the land such as these, for what purpose do I further live; for the daughters of Canaan are evil."* (Jubilees 27:8). The restored witness gives Rebecca's plea behind the charge *Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan* (Genesis 28:1) — *the daughters of Canaan are evil* — the covenant mother grieved by Esau's marriages and resolved that Jacob shall not follow.

quote: "Do not take you a wife of any of the daughters of Canaan; arise and go to Mesopotamia, to the house of Bethuel, your mother's father, and take you a wife from thence of the daughters of Laban, your mother's brother."
live_here: “Do not take you a wife of any of the daughters of Canaan; arise and go to Mesopotamia, to the house of Bethuel, your mother’s father, and take you a wife from thence of the daughters of Laban, your mother’s brother.

note: *"Do not take you a wife of any of the daughters of Canaan; arise and go to Mesopotamia, to the house of Bethuel, your mother's father, and take you a wife from thence of the daughters of Laban, your mother's brother."* (Jubilees 27:10). The restored witness keeps Isaac's charge whole — *go to Mesopotamia... take you a wife of the daughters of Laban* — matching *Arise, go to Padan-aram, to the house of Bethuel thy mother's father; and take thee a wife from thence of the daughters of Laban thy mother's brother* (Genesis 28:2): the bride drawn from the covenant kindred, not the daughters of Canaan.

quote: "And El Shaddai (God Almighty) bless you and increase and multiply you that you may become a company of nations, and give you the blessings of my father Abraham, to you and to your seed after you, that you may inherit the land of your sojournings and all the land which Elohim (God) gave to Abraham."

live_proposed: And El Shaddai (God Almighty) bless you and increase and multiply you that you may become a company of nations, and give you the blessings of my father Abraham, to you and to your seed after you, that you may inherit the land of your sojournings and all the land which Elohim (God) gave to Abraham: go, my son, in peace.”

The restored witness keeps Isaac's blessing entire — *El Shaddai bless you... give you the blessings of my father Abraham, to you and to your seed after you, that you may inherit the land of your sojournings* — matching *And El Shaddai (God Almighty) bless thee... And give thee the blessing of Abraham, to thee, and to thy seed with thee; that thou mayest inherit the land* (Genesis 28:3-4): the Abrahamic covenant explicitly handed to Jacob.

note: *And behold, Yahuah (God) stood upon it. And He spake to Jacob and said: "I am Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Abraham, your father, and the Elohim (God) of Isaac; the land whereon you are sleeping, to you shall I give it, and to your-seed after you."* (Jubilees 27:22). The restored witness keeps the One atop the ladder who bears the Name — *Yahuah stood upon it... I am Yahuah Elohim of Abraham, your father, and the Elohim of Isaac* — matching *behold, Yahuah (LORD) stood above it, and said, I am Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Abraham thy father, and the Elohim (God) of Isaac* (Genesis 28:13): the Formed Yahuah who appears and speaks, renewing the land to Jacob and his seed.

quote: your seed will be as the dust of the earth... in you and in your seed will all the families of the nations be blessed

The restored witness keeps the seed-promise whole — *your seed will be as the dust of the earth... in you and in your seed will all the families of the nations be blessed* — verse-for-verse with *And thy seed shall be as the dust of the earth... and in thee and in thy seed shall all the families of the earth be blessed* (Genesis 28:14): the dust-numbered seed and the blessing of the families spoken over Jacob.

quote: And Jacob awoke from his sleep, and said, "Truly this place is the house of Yahuah (God), and I knew it not." And he was afraid and said: "Dreadful is this place which is none other than the house of Elohim (God), and this is the gate of heaven."

live_proposed: And Jacob awoke from his sleep, and said, “Truly this place is the house of Yahuah (God), and I knew it not.” And he was afraid and said:" Dreadful is this place which is none other than the house of Elohim (God), and this is the gate of heaven."

And he was afraid and said: "Dreadful is this place which is none other than the house of Elohim (God), and this is the gate of heaven."* (Jubilees 27:25). The restored witness keeps Jacob's waking cry whole — *the house of Yahuah... none other than the house of Elohim, and this is the gate of heaven* — matching *Surely Yahuah (LORD) is in this place... this is none other but the house of Elohim (God), and this is the gate of heaven* (Genesis 28:16-17).

The restored witness keeps the vow entire — *If Yahuah will be with me... then shall Yahuah be my Elohim... and of all that you give me, I shall give the tenth to you* — matching *And Jacob vowed a vow... If Elohim (God) will be with me... then shall Yahuah (LORD) be my Elohim (God)... and of all that thou shalt give me I will surely give the tenth unto thee* (Genesis 28:20-22).

quote: And Yahuah (God) sent a mighty wind against the tower and overthrew it upon the earth, and behold it was between Asshur and Babylon in the land of Shinar, and they called its name "Overthrow."

note: Jubilees 10:26 — *And Yahuah (God) sent a mighty wind against the tower and overthrew it upon the earth, and behold it was between Asshur and Babylon in the land of Shinar, and they called its name "Overthrow."* Jubilees records the same tower of strife overthrown and its builders judged that 3 Baruch 2:7 places in the first heaven.

quote: And He confounded their language, and they no longer understood one another's speech, and they ceased then to build the city and the tower.
live_here: And He confounded their language, and they no longer understood one another’s speech, and they ceased then to build the city and the tower.
live_proposed: And He confounded their language, and they no longer understood one another’s speech, and they ceased then to build the city and the tower.
note: Jubilees 10:24 — *And He confounded their language, and they no longer understood one another's speech, and they ceased then to build the city and the tower.* Jubilees records the same confounding of speech and ceasing of the work that 3 Baruch 3:8 describes.

quote: And they began to build, and in the fourth week they made brick with fire, and the bricks served them for stone, and the clay with which they cemented them together was asphalt which comes out of the sea, and out of the fountains of water in the land of Shinar.

note: Jubilees 10:20 — *And they began to build, and in the fourth week they made brick with fire, and the bricks served them for stone, and the clay with which they cemented them together was asphalt which comes out of the sea, and out of the fountains of water in the land of Shinar.* Jubilees records the same brick-making in Shinar that 3 Baruch 3:5 says was driven on the multitudes by force.

quote: And Laban said to Jacob: "It is not so done in our country, to give the younger before the elder." And it is not right to do this; for thus it is ordained and written in the heavenly tables, that no one should give his younger daughter before the elder

live_proposed: And Laban said to Jacob: “It is not so done in our country, to give the younger before the elder.” And it is not right to do this; for thus it is ordained and written in the heavenly tables, that no one should give his younger daughter before the elder–but the elder one gives first and after her the younger–and the man who does so, they set down guilt against him in heaven, and none is righteous that does this thing, for this deed is evil before Yahuah (God).
note: *And Laban said to Jacob: "It is not so done in our country, to give the younger before the elder." And it is not right to do this; for thus it is ordained and written in the heavenly tables, that no one should give his younger daughter before the elder* (Jubilees 28:6). The restored witness keeps Laban's rule — *it is not so done in our country, to give the younger before the elder* — and roots it in the heavenly tables, matching *It must not be so done in our country, to give the younger before the firstborn* (Genesis 29:26): the very order Jacob overturned for himself is the ordained order he is now made to keep.

quote: And Yahuah (God) opened the womb of Leah, and she conceived and bare Jacob a son, and he called his name Reuben... But the womb of Rachel was closed, for Yahuah (God) saw that Leah was hated and Rachel loved
live_here: And Yahuah (God) opened the womb of Leah, and she conceived and bare Jacob a son, and he called his name Reuben, on the fourteenth day of the ninth month, in the first year of the third week.
live_proposed: And Yahuah (God) opened the womb of Leah, and she conceived and bare Jacob a son, and he called his name Reuben, on the fourteenth day of the ninth month, in the first year of the third week.
note: *And Yahuah (God) opened the womb of Leah, and she conceived and bare Jacob a son, and he called his name Reuben... But the womb of Rachel was closed, for Yahuah (God) saw that Leah was hated and Rachel loved* (Jubilees 28:11). The restored witness keeps the turn whole — *Yahuah opened the womb of Leah... for Yahuah saw that Leah was hated* — matching *when Yahuah (LORD) saw that Leah was hated, he opened her womb: but Rachel was barren* (Genesis 29:31). The unloved wife is the one Yahuah visits first; the foundation of the tribes is laid in her affliction.

quote: And again Jacob went in to Leah, and she conceived, and bare Jacob a second son, and he called his name Simeon

live_proposed: And again Jacob went in to Leah, and she conceived, and bare Jacob a second son, and he called his name Simeon, on the twenty-first of the tenth month, and in the third year of this week.
note: *And again Jacob went in to Leah, and she conceived, and bare Jacob a second son, and he called his name Simeon* (Jubilees 28:13). The restored witness names the second son with Genesis 29:33 — *she conceived again, and bare a son... she called his name Simeon* — the tribal fathers come one after another from the hated wife's opened womb, each birth a stone laid in the house of Yashar'el (Israel).

quote: And again Jacob went in to Leah, and she conceived, and bare him a third son, and he called his name Levi... And again Jacob went in to her, and she conceived, and bare him a fourth son, and he called his name Yahudah (Judah)
live_here: And again Jacob went in to her, and she conceived, and bare him a fourth son, and he called his name Yahudah (Judah), on the fifteenth of the third month, in the first year of the fourth week.
live_proposed: And again Jacob went in to her, and she conceived, and bare him a fourth son, and he called his name Yahudah (Judah), on the fifteenth of the third month, in the first year of the fourth week.
note: *And again Jacob went in to Leah, and she conceived, and bare him a third son, and he called his name Levi... And again Jacob went in to her, and she conceived, and bare him a fourth son, and he called his name Yahudah (Judah)* (Jubilees 28:15). The restored witness carries Levi and Judah together — the priestly tribe and the kingly tribe born back to back — matching *she called his name Levi* (Genesis 29:34) and *she called his name Yahudah (Judah)* (Genesis 29:35). The two tribes that will carry the altar and the scepter come from the wife Yahuah remembered.

The restored witness carries the increase whole — *Jacob's possessions multiplied exceedingly* — matching *the man increased exceedingly, and had much cattle, and maidservants, and menservants, and camels, and asses* (Genesis 30:43); and it names what follows, Laban's envy, the strife of ch31 already gathering.

The restored witness carries the obedience to *Return unto the land of thy fathers, and to thy kindred* (Genesis 31:3) — Jacob *crossed the river, and came to the land of Gilead*, setting his face homeward as he was bidden, blessing the Elohim of his fathers as he goes.

Therefore was the name of it called Galeed* (Genesis 31:48) — *he made there a heap for a witness... "The Heap of Witness."* The piled stones stand as the silent testimony of the covenant sworn between the parted parties.

The restored witness names the meeting outright — *Esau, his brother, came to him, and he was reconciled to him* — the dread of the four hundred men of Genesis 33:1 turned to the embrace of *Esau ran to meet him, and embraced him, and fell on his neck* (Genesis 33:4).

note: *And there they carried off Dinah, the daughter of Jacob, into the house of Shechem, the son of Hamor, the Hivite, the prince of the land, and he lay with her and defiled her, and she was a little girl, a child of twelve years* (Jubilees 30:2). The restored witness keeps the defilement entire — *he lay with her and defiled her* — matching *Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, prince of the country, saw her, he took her, and lay with her, and defiled her* (Genesis 34:2), and adds the weight of her youth, a child carried off. The holy seed-line of Jacob is violated by the prince of the nations.

note: *And thus let it not again be done from henceforth that a daughter of Yashar'el (Israel) be defiled; for judgment is ordained in heaven against them that they should destroy with the sword all the men of the Shechemites because they had wrought shame in Yashar'el (Israel)* (Jubilees 30:5). The restored witness echoes the very charge of *he had wrought folly in Yashar'el (Israel) in lying with Jacob's daughter; which thing ought not to be done* (Genesis 34:7) — *they had wrought shame in Yashar'el*. The defiling of a daughter of the covenant is no private wrong but a shame against the whole set-apart people.
